# How To Start a Fundraiser

You can create a custom fundraising page on your CrowdChange site in under 5 minutes!

Simply follow the steps below:

1. Click the **Start A Fundraiser** button in the top-right corner of your CrowdChange site.

   ![startfunds.png](../assets/how-to-start-a-fundraiser/startfunds.png)
2. Fill out the **General Information** page, toggling on any features you'd like to use for your fundraiser under **Purchase options**. For example:

   ![image-20240823-143705.png](../assets/how-to-start-a-fundraiser/image-20240823-143705.png)  
   ![image-20240823-143736.png](../assets/how-to-start-a-fundraiser/image-20240823-143736.png)
3. Click **Next** and further customize your fundraiser on the **Additional Settings**page, enabling P2P features and more as/if needed.

   ![image-20240823-143918.png](../assets/how-to-start-a-fundraiser/image-20240823-143918.png)
4. Click **Create Fundraiser** at the bottom to sign up / log in and publish your fundraiser.

5. Use the **Share**button to get the word out to your friends \& family!

Please see the following related tutorials as well:

* [How Ticketing Works](how-ticketing-works.md)
* [How Merchandise Works](how-merchandise-works.md)
* [How Registration Works](how-registration-works.md)
* [How Sponsorship Works (Sponsorship Packages)](how-sponsorship-works-sponsorship-packages.md)
* [How to Create a Personal Fundraising Page \& Share It](how-to-create-a-personal-fundraising-page-share-it.md)
* [How to Create a Team \& Invite Members](how-to-create-a-team-invite-members.md)
## Detailed Steps:

1. Click the **Start A Fundraiser** button in the top-right corner of your CrowdChange site.

2. Fill out the **General Information** page:

   1. Fundraiser is bilingual - This allows you to enter all information in both English and French.

   2. Fundraiser Name - Set a name for your fundraiser that will be the main heading.

   3. In support of - You may be allowed to choose from a list of options, or type your own.

   4. Goal - You can turn the goal feature on or off, and set it to either a certain amount raised, or a certain number of donors.

   5. Date and time - Turn this on if you want to show a start date / time for your fundraiser.

   6. Fundraiser has an end date and time - Turn this on if you want to show an end date / time for your fundraiser.

   7. Fundraiser has a location - Turn this on if you want to show the location of your fundraiser.

   8. Fundraiser Description - Enter all the information donors \& participants will need to know.

   9. Cover Image - Upload a banner / header image for your fundraiser.

   10. Add a Video - Allows you to paste a video link so that a video will be displayed instead of the Cover Photo on your fundraising page.

3. Under **Purchase options**enable any features you want to use for your fundraiser:

   1. My event has tickets - See **How Ticketing Works**

   2. My event has apparel / merchandise - See **How Merchandise Works**

   3. My event has registration - See **How Registration Works**

   4. My event offers sponsorship packages - See **How Sponsorships Work**

   5. My fundraiser has custom questions - See **How to Use Custom Questions**

4. Click **Next** and enable **Peer-to-peer features**:

   1. Personal fundraising pages - See **How to Create Personal Page**

   2. Team fundraising pages - See **How to Create a Team**

   3. Personal fundraising pages within teams - Allow personal pages to be created under teams.

   4. Set default content for personal pages - Set a default description for personal pages.

   5. Set default content for team pages - Set a default description for team pages.

5. Enable and set up **Registration Features** if desired and if Multi-Registration is enabled on your site.

6. **Advanced Features**:

   1. Donations are tax deductible - Enable only if you will be issuing tax receipts for this fundraiser.

   2. eCards - Turn on and select **Tribute Cards** if you would like to set up personal pages 'In honor of' or 'In memory of' individuals. Otherwise, select **eCards**.

   3. Collect Mailing Information - Turn on if you want to collect donor mailing information specifically.

   4. Allows donors without emails to use their physical address - Let donors donate \& register without an email address.

   5. Hidden event - Hide fundraiser from the public so only Admins and those with a link can find it.

   6. Show list of donors - Turn on if you want a public donor list for your fundraiser.

   7. Start accepting funds on date - Turn on if you want the fundraiser to open automatically at a certain date / time. A countdown will be displayed.

   8. Stop accepting funds on date - Be sure to turn this on to set a close-off date for your fundraiser.

   9. Donation matching - Enable if you would like donations to be matched. You will be able to set up the matching pool and settings through **Donation Matching** once enabled.

7. Click the **Create Fundraiser** button to sign up or log in - if you haven't already, otherwise, you are ready to start sharing your fundraiser!

You can hide the 'Share' button on your fundraiser if desired using the steps below:

1. From your fundraiser, click **Manage Fundraiser** in the top-right corner.

2. Click **Design your fundraiser**.

3. Hover over your banner/hero image and click the **Gear**icon on the left.

4. On the right sidebar, within the **Layout** section, click **Set up sharing**.

5. Disable **Show on page** and click **Save**at the bottom.

# Customizing your fundraiser UI & design

CrowdChange's offers a fully customizable fundraising page with detailed options for branding, layouts and content!

Fundraisers are built in a 'block' structure and are designed on a block-by-block basis with each section representing a different element of your fundraiser. Personal \& team pages will inherit the visual format of the overall fundraiser. *These layouts will appear slightly differently on mobile devices for screen optimization.*  
![image-20231123-161432.png](../assets/customizing-your-fundraiser-ui-design/image-20231123-161432.png)
Full-screen "Hero" Layout  
![image-20231123-161554.png](../assets/customizing-your-fundraiser-ui-design/image-20231123-161554.png)
Full-screen Gallery Layout - Same as "Hero", but with slideshow of multiple images.

Unknown Attachment

Unknown Attachment

*** ** * ** ***

**Please Note** : Before you can access editing features, you must click **Manage your fundraiser** as shown below.

Unknown Attachment

From your fundraiser dashboard click **Design your fundraiser** and click the "**Edit**" button in the top right corner.

Unknown Attachment

## Blocks and Design Controls

The fundraiser UI uses the 'block' structure, whereby fundraiser pages are built on a block-by-block basis. As shown in the image below, you have the ability to **add** , **edit** , **move** , **hide** or **delete** blocks.

Unknown Attachment

There are different types of blocks available depending on the settings of your fundraiser and each has a different function. Here are the block types with a brief description:

* **Donation Progress** block - Shows total amount raised, progress bar, fundraiser goal (if enabled), amount raised by teams and pages, number of donors, as desired. This block is very customizable.

* **Text**block - Allows you to enter a header title and text body.

* **When and Where** block - Allows you to display date(s) and pinpoint a geographic location.

* **Leaderboard**block - Allows you to display Top or Recent Donations, Top Teams and Top Pages.

* **Join fundraiser** block - Displays option to Join Fundraiser and create P2P pages. If a user has already joined they will see a list of any created pages with a 'Take me there' button.

* **Customer support**block - Displays 'Contact Us' button which brings up a contact form for support.

* **Purchase options** blocks - These will show up as Registrations, Tickets, Apparel or Sponsorsblocks depending on the settings of your fundraiser. They provide a quicker way for users to see and select purchase options.

* **eCards**block - Available if eCards is enabled within fundraiser settings. Allows you to display select eCards on your fundraiser's main page.

## Fundraiser and Layout Options

For Admins and Fundraiser Owners managing their fundraiser, options such as **Edit** , **Offline Donations** , **Mailing List, Reports, Purchase options** and more will be found under the fundraiser dashboard when clicking **Manager fundraiser** in the top left corner of the screen.

Basic color and style options are found under **Theme Settings** , but to edit the overall design of the page, you must click the **Gear** icon on below the theme setting.

Unknown Attachment

Once you click the**Gear**icon, a scrollable side panel will appear on the right with more fundraiser options.

This is where you can go to edit your fundraiser title, choose which buttons are shown and in what order, change the layout, images, background and more. Be sure to scroll down and click **Save**.

Unknown Attachment

## Share Feature \& Block

The **Share** feature has also been updated, with more sharing options now available such as **QR code** , **WhatsApp** , **Twitter** , and **sharing to other apps**. The Share button also now exists within it's own block.

Unknown Attachment

The text, design and placement of the Share block can be customized by following these steps:

1. From the fundraiser, go to **Manage fundraiser → Design your fundraiser**.

2. Click the **Gear** icon that appears while hovering over the **Share block.**

3. From the Sharing menu, you can make adjustments to the Share block as shown below.

   Unknown Attachment

## A Note on P2P Pages

Personal and Team fundraising pages will inherit the visual format of the overall fundraiser, including buttons shown. The position of the 'Manage my Page' (or Team) and 'Share' buttons also follows the new design.

To navigate from your personal fundraising page to the main fundraiser or your connected team page, you must now click **Fundraiser and team details**, then select either the fundraiser or the team page.

Unknown Attachment

# How to Close or Reopen a Fundraiser

## To Close a Fundraiser

1. Go to the fundraiser you would like to close.

2. Click **Manage Fundraiser**in the top-right corner.

3. Click the **triple-dot icon** in the top right corner, then **Close Fundraiser → Yes**.

This will close the fundraiser and stop it from accepting ticket sales or transactions of any kind.  
![ef8a262b-cb87-4c74-8dbd-c9d6e4d78502.png](../assets/how-to-close-or-reopen-a-fundraiser/ef8a262b-cb87-4c74-8dbd-c9d6e4d78502.png)  
Even if a fundraiser has been closed, it is **still visible to the public**.

To make it **invisible to the public** , only accessible by Admins and those with a direct link, go to **Manage Fundraiser** ,click **Additional Settings** , and turn on the **Hidden event** feature.  
**TIP:** We recommend leaving your fundraiser open for at least a week after your event date, so that people who couldn't make it can still donate.

The auto-close date is set on the **General Settings** page under **Dates → Select when to accept funds → Stop accepting funds on date**.

## To Reopen a Fundraiser

1. Go to the fundraiser you would like to reopen.

2. Click **Manage Fundraiser** in the top-right corner.

3. Click the **triple-dot icon** in the top right corner, then **Re-open Fundraiser → Yes**.

This will reopen the fundraiser and allow all transactions to proceed.  
![testz.png](../assets/how-to-close-or-reopen-a-fundraiser/testz.png)

# How to Archive a Fundraiser

## To Archive a Fundraiser

Please note that fundraisers must first be closed before they can be archived.

Refer to the steps in 'How to Close or Reopen a Fundraiser' before continuing.

1. Go to the closed fundraiser you would like to archive.

2. Click **Manage Fundraiser** in the top-right corner.

3. Click the **triple-dot icon** in the top-right corner, then**Archive → Yes**.

   ![0d312461-4840-43d1-a9d3-ae58ca088613.png](../assets/how-to-archive-a-fundraiser/0d312461-4840-43d1-a9d3-ae58ca088613.png)

   ![yesz.png](../assets/how-to-archive-a-fundraiser/yesz.png)

This will archive the fundraiser - it will be hidden from the list of fundraisers and only accessible to Admins (not visible to the public) and it will not be capable of accepting sales or transactions of any kind.

## To Un-archive a Fundraiser

1. Go to the fundraiser you would like to restore from archive.

2. Click**Manage Fundraiser**in the top-right corner.

3. Click the**triple** **-dot icon** , then **Restore from Archive → Yes**.

   ![next1.png](../assets/how-to-archive-a-fundraiser/next1.png)  
   ![yeszz.png](../assets/how-to-archive-a-fundraiser/yeszz.png)

This will un-archive the fundraiser, restoring it to the list of fundraisers, and making it publicly visible, but it will remain closed until manually reopened. You can re-open it to allow transactions to proceed again.

# How to Change the Date and Time of your Fundraiser

YYou have the ability within your fundraiser settings to adjust the **public-facing** **start** **date \& time** of your fundraiser, as well as the **public-facing** **end** **date \& time**.  
![image-20240816-175123.png](../assets/how-to-change-the-date-and-time-of-your-fundraiser/image-20240816-175123.png)

Additionally, you may adjust the 'cut-off'**end** **date for accepting funds** , and **start** **date for accepting funds**.  
![image-20240816-175235.png](../assets/how-to-change-the-date-and-time-of-your-fundraiser/image-20240816-175235.png)

## Written Steps:

1. Go to your fundraising page on your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click on **Manage Fundraiser**in the upper right hand corner.

3. Go to **General Settings** on the left sidebar.

4. Scroll down to the **Dates** section and click '**Date and Time** ' or '**Select when to accept funds**'.

5. Set the dates and times for each to your liking and click **Save**.

# How to Change Cover Photo

Need to change your fundraiser's cover / banner / Hero image? It's simple, just follow these easy steps:

1. Go to your fundraising page and ensure you are logged in.

2. Click **Manage My Fundraiser** in the top right corner of the page.

   ![image-20250709-142936.png](../assets/how-to-change-cover-photo/image-20250709-142936.png)
3. Click the **Design your fundraiser** button.

   ![image-20250709-143036.png](../assets/how-to-change-cover-photo/image-20250709-143036.png)
4. Hover over the fundraiser's current image and click the **Gear**icon that appears on the top right of the page.

   ![image-20250709-142714.png](../assets/how-to-change-cover-photo/image-20250709-142714.png)
5. On the right sidebar that appears, scroll down and expand the **Content**section.

6. Click on the **pencil**icons to change the current images.

7. Select the new image from your computer, crop and edit if desired, and click **Save**.

   ![savez.png](../assets/how-to-change-cover-photo/savez.png)
8. At the bottom of the sidebar, click **Save** to confirm and publish your changes.

   ![savezz.png](../assets/how-to-change-cover-photo/savezz.png)

# How to Change Your Fundraising Goal

Getting more donations come through than you ever expected? Changing your fundraising goal is simple!

*Please note that you must first be logged in to perform this action.*

1. From your fundraising page, click **Manage Fundraiser** in the top right corner.

   ![managez.png](../assets/how-to-change-your-fundraising-goal/managez.png)
2. Click **General Settings** on the left sidebar.

3. Scroll down to **Goal Measure Unit**, and adjust the goal amount as desired.

   ![image-20240816-195323.png](../assets/how-to-change-your-fundraising-goal/image-20240816-195323.png)
4. Scroll down to the bottom of the page and click **Save**.

   ![image-20240816-195633.png](../assets/how-to-change-your-fundraising-goal/image-20240816-195633.png)

## For Personal Page Goals...

1. From your Personal page (while logged in), click **Manage my Page** then **Page Settings**.

2. Change the amount under **Fundraiser page goal**as desired.

3. Click the **Save** button at the bottom.

## For Team Page Goals...

1. From your Team page (while logged in), click **Manage my Team** then **Team Settings**.

2. Change the amount under **Team goal**as desired.

3. Click the **Save** button at the bottom.

# How to Create a Personal Fundraising Page & Share It

Use our **Personal Fundraising Pages** feature to raise significantly more with your fundraisers and increase supporter engagement!

To use this feature, be sure to turn on **Personal fundraising pages** on the **Additional Settings** page when you are setting up or editing your fundraiser.

Once enabled, participants will be able to click **Join this fundraiser** **→ Create a personal page.**  
![join.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-personal-fundraising-page-share-it/join.png)  
![createpage.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-personal-fundraising-page-share-it/createpage.png)

Participants will then be prompted to enter their **Name** and **Fundraising Goal** for the page. If desired, they can also add their own **image** , **video** , or **text description** , by turning **OFF**the following toggles:  
![toggles.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-personal-fundraising-page-share-it/toggles.png)

They will then be prompted to upload an image or video, and enter their own description for the page.  
![toggles2.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-personal-fundraising-page-share-it/toggles2.png)

When they have finished, they can click **Start a Fundraising Page** at the bottom to complete this process.  
![image-20221028-194311.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-personal-fundraising-page-share-it/image-20221028-194311.png)

## Sharing A Personal Fundraising Page

Nothing is more effective for increasing engagement and raising more money than sharing with friends and family, whether that's via our Social Media share buttons, our Mailing List feature, or simply word of mouth.

### Sending emails using the CrowdChange 'Mailing List' feature

**Step 1:** Once participants create their personal fundraising pages, they can share directly to social media using the **Share** button. Mass emails can also be sent using the **Mailing List** , which can be accessed via **Advanced Settings → Mailing List** . For steps on using the **Mailing List**, please continue to Step 2.

**Step 2:** Click "**Contacts** " from the Mailing List main page. Next, click "**Add Contacts** " in the upper right corner of the page and select whether you would like to import contacts from a CSV file, Gmail, Outlook, manually, and more. Once you have imported your contacts, click "**Save Contacts** ." Once completed, click "**Back to Mailing List**".

**Step 3:** Click "**New Campaign** " from the Mailing List's main page. Select your desired recipients by clicking the '**To** ' field, and choosing from the list of Imported Contacts, Donors or Previous Donors using the drop-down menu in the top left corner. The Donors list will show contacts who have made a donation to your page. Click "**Add Recipients**" to proceed.

**Step 4:** Under the "**Select email template** "section, select "**Use blank template**" to create your own email message. If any custom templates have been created, either by you or an admin, they will be available in this section as well.

**Step 5:** Select "**Click here** " under the "**From**" field to add yourself as the sender. A pop-up will ask for your name and email address. Once entered, CrowdChange will send a verification code to your email to confirm your identity.

**Step 6:** When you receive the email verification code, copy/paste the code into your CrowdChange page and click **Verify**. If you did not receive a verification email, please click resend verification code.

**Step 7:**Enter your subject line, your desired email text or edit an existing template by using the editing options within the Message editor. Note: If you are sending this from a bilingual fundraiser, you will be prompted to enter a subject line \& email message for both English and French.

**Step 8:** As you finalize your email, click "**Send Preview Email** " to send yourself a preview. To save this as a template, toggle on "**Save this message as a template for future use** ", confirm the message complies with your regional/national anti-spam laws and click "**Send**" to send it off!  
From the Mailing List's main page, you can track delivery details for all recipients of your email campaigns by clicking "**View Report**" next to the desired campaign. This report will help you to understand which contacts have received and/or opened your email campaigns.  
For more in-depth info on the Mailing List and Templates, see the following tutorials:

**How Email Templates Work**

**How to Create a Custom Email Template**

**How to Edit a Pre-existing Email Template**

# How to Change Photo and Description on a Personal Page

You can **customize** your Personal Fundraising Page by adding your own **photo** and **description text**, in place of the main fundraiser defaults!

To do so, follow the steps below:

1. From your Personal Fundraising Page, click **Manage my Page** in the top right.

   ![image-20240821-200716.png](../assets/how-to-change-photo-and-description-on-a-personal-/image-20240821-200716.png)

   1. **Use default image and video**

   2. **Use default description**

      ![arrows.png](/__attachments/a_e363e88d7eadd6d6869b2d83b8a9f0e44ae4d0acbbbf965a19e12e368eb5d7b8/arrows.png?cb=65e508118f64bd32d6cd2ee6624d85e9)
3. Upload your image or video, add any desired text, scroll down and click **Save**.

# Importance of using Personal Fundraising Pages (P2P)

Personal Fundraising Pages are CrowdChange's **most effective tool** for raising more money with your fundraisers!

We recommend that everyone in your Chapter creates a Personal Fundraising Page and shares it with five people outside of campus. We've seen a ton of success with this method and Chapters have raised over 235% more than they would have originally.

It takes only **30 seconds** for each brother or sister to create their own Personal Fundraising Page!

For step by step instructions, see **How to Create a Personal Fundraising Page \& Share It**

# How to Manage Personal Pages & Teams

As an Admin user, there's a quick and simple way to manage all personal pages and teams that have been created and create new ones. Just use our intuitive **Manage Personal Pages \& Teams** feature!

You can also use this feature to manually create a personal page or team for a user who has accidentally deleted their own.

To get started, go to your fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

Click **Manage pages and teams** on the left sidebar.  
![image-20250806-162539.png](../assets/how-to-manage-personal-pages-teams/image-20250806-162539.png)

Once inside the **Manage pages and teams** menu, you can see helpful statistics on your pages, and you have the ability to both create new pages, and view the list of existing pages.

To the right of each page in the list, you can click the **triple-dot icon** to access management options such as:

**Resend Invite, Close, Archive, Un-Archive** and **Delete**.  
![image-20250806-162729.png](../assets/how-to-manage-personal-pages-teams/image-20250806-162729.png)

* Clicking the name of the page (on the left) will take you directly to the page.

* Clicking the **Resend Invite** option allows you to re-send the invitation email to the page owner.

* Clicking the **Archive** option allows you to directly archive the page.

* Clicking the **Delete** option allows you to fully delete the page. Before deletion you must give a reason.

## Creating a page for a user/participant

To create a page for a user or participant, follow the simple steps below:

1. Click **Create personal page** in the top right corner.

   ![image-20250806-163813.png](../assets/how-to-manage-personal-pages-teams/image-20250806-163813.png)

2. Enter their email address under 'Create Personal Page' and click **Next**.

   ![image-20250806-163925.png](../assets/how-to-manage-personal-pages-teams/image-20250806-163925.png)

3. If they already have a CrowdChange account, their first and last name will populate automatically - if not, enter their first and last name.

   ![image-20250806-164217.png](../assets/how-to-manage-personal-pages-teams/image-20250806-164217.png)

4. Confirm the name and goal amount of the page, connect it to a team if desired, and click **Create personal page** tofinalize.

   ![image-20250806-164325.png](../assets/how-to-manage-personal-pages-teams/image-20250806-164325.png)

If the user does not already have a CrowdChange account, after the page is created, an invitation email will be sent to them, prompting them to create an account before managing it.

You may also edit the automated trigger email that is sent when a personal page is created by an Admin on someone's behalf. This can be found under **Manage Fundraiser → Automated Email Templates → Personal page created by administrator** .**or**.

# How to Link Registrations to Personal & Team Pages

If you need to **require registrations** (free or paid) for everyone who creates a Personal or Team Fundraising Page, you can accomplish this easily in your fundraiser settings.

Follow these steps to link Registrations to P2P:

1. Go to your Main Fundraising Page and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

2. Click **Purchase Options**on the left sidebar.

3. Click **Registration** , enable it,then click **Save**.

4. Click **Peer-to-peer settings**on the left sidebar and enable the following:

   1. **Personal fundraising pages**

      1. ***Personal fundraising pages under a team can be created***

      2. ***Registration is required to create a personal page***

      3. ***Registrants are required to create a personal page with an email address (no opt-out)***

   2. **Team fundraising pages**

      1. ***Registration is required to create a team***

5. Ensure to **Save Changes**within each section.

This will require registrants to create their Personal or Team Page during checkout.

There will no longer be an option to create a Personal or Team Page without registration.

Your fundraiser will now take on the 'multi-registration' workflow:  
![image-20250717-181130.png](../assets/how-to-link-registrations-to-personal-team-pages/image-20250717-181130.png)

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/registering-for-a-peer-to-peer-registration-event | Nav: How to Link Registrations to Personal & Team Pages > Registering for a Peer to Peer + Registration Event | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Registering for a Peer to Peer + Registration Event

Here's what the process looks like for a donor when registering for a fundraiser with Peer-to-Peer Pages and Registration linked together as described in parent article.

## **Step 1** : Go the fundraising page and click **Register** .

![registerz.png](../assets/registering-for-a-peer-to-peer-registration-event/registerz.png)

### **Step 2** : Select either **Start a team** , **Join a team** , or **Register as an individual** .

![image-20250215-203825.png](../assets/registering-for-a-peer-to-peer-registration-event/image-20250215-203825.png)
Start a team  
You will be prompted to enter a team name, goal amount and depending on the setup of the site, other required info such as custom question responses, super team selections and more.  
![image-20250215-204435.png](../assets/registering-for-a-peer-to-peer-registration-event/image-20250215-204435.png)

Once you click Create, you will then be prompted to fill out **Registrant Details**as below for your first registrant (yourself).
Join a team  
You will be able tosearch for a team to join, or join an existing one from those listed.

If you change your mind, you can simply click 'Start a team' at the top to create your own.  
![image-20250215-204050.png](../assets/registering-for-a-peer-to-peer-registration-event/image-20250215-204050.png)

If you find an existing team you'd like to join, click the **Join team**button next to it:  
![jointeam.png](../assets/registering-for-a-peer-to-peer-registration-event/jointeam.png)

You will then be prompted to fill out **Registrant Details**as below for your first registrant (yourself).
Join as an individual  
You will be prompted to fill out **Registrant Details**as below for your first registrant (yourself).

### **Step 3** : When registering yourself or others, you will need to fill out **Registrant Details** first.

![image-20231023-142834.png](../assets/registering-for-a-peer-to-peer-registration-event/image-20231023-142834.png)

### **Step 4** : After filling out Registrant Details, create a **Personal Fundraising Page** to share with friends and family and raise support! We recommend selecting a personal donation amount to kick-start your fundraising. You may set the donation display name, comment, and whether to show or hide the amount (shown below).

![image-20231023-142956.png](../assets/registering-for-a-peer-to-peer-registration-event/image-20231023-142956.png)

### **Step 4:** Complete any other required information such as custom question responses.

### **Step 5:** Scroll down to the bottom of the page and click one of the options below:

#### **- Save \& add new registrant** to add another registrant.

#### - **Save \& checkout** to continue to checkout.

Please note: If you created a Team, the **first**registrant will be assigned as the Team Captain.

If you add more registrants, you will be given the option of making them the team captain.

### **Step 6** : On the **Checkout** page, you can review your transaction details, and make any desired adjustments to self donation and general donation amounts. (See screenshot below)

![checkout.png](../assets/registering-for-a-peer-to-peer-registration-event/checkout.png)

### **Step 7** : Fill out your email address under**General Information** (if not already logged in), and if making a donation at checkout, feel free to change the public display name and comment that will be shown with your donation.

![generalinfo.png](../assets/registering-for-a-peer-to-peer-registration-event/generalinfo.png)

### **Step 8** : Enter your **Payment, Billing and/or Mailing Information** , and click **Complete** .

![paymentinfo.png](../assets/registering-for-a-peer-to-peer-registration-event/paymentinfo.png)

### **Step 9** : Go to your **Personal Fundraising Page** by clicking **Back to Page** on the 'Thank You' page that appears, or via the email confirmation you received after creation.

![image-20250215-205613.png](../assets/registering-for-a-peer-to-peer-registration-event/image-20250215-205613.png)

# How to Access the Registrations Report (Fundraiser Level) - Multi-registration fundraisers only

As the host of a multi-registration enabled fundraiser, your **Registrations Report**is where you can find details about all registrants and registration transactions. You can search/filter by email address, transaction ID or page name, and download an Excel report of all registrations.

To access it, follow these simple steps:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Go to your multi-registration enabled fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

3. On the left sidebar, click**Reports** and then **Registrations Report**.

   ![image-20250729-140114.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-registrations-report-fundraiser-/image-20250729-140114.png)

4. You will be taken to the **Registration Report** page, where you can see detailed information on all registration transactions. If you're looking for information on a specific registrant, you can use the search bar and search by email address, transaction ID or page name.

   ![image-20250729-140426.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-registrations-report-fundraiser-/image-20250729-140426.png)

You can download a more detailed CSV version of this report by clicking **Download**in the top right.

The email you receive with download link will have the subject 'Registration Report'.

It will also contain the answers to custom checkout and registration questions.

# How to Share your Personal Fundraising Page

Once you have created your personal fundraising page, follow these simple steps to share it with friends and family and raise support!

1. Go to your personal fundraising page.

2. Click the **Share**button (either above or below the Hero image).

   ![share1.png](../assets/how-to-share-your-personal-fundraising-page/share1.png)
3. On the overlay menu that appears, select your preferred sharing option.

   ![image-20240619-163556.png](../assets/how-to-share-your-personal-fundraising-page/image-20240619-163556.png)
4. A new window will open prompting you to log in to the specific platform in order to share your fundraising page.

For more app share options, click '**Share with other apps**' at the bottom.

Alternatively, you can copy the link and share it manually, or use the QR Code option.

# How to Create a Team & Invite Members

Use our **Team Fundraising Pages** feature to raise significantly more with your fundraisers and increase supporter engagement!

To use this feature, be sure to turn on **Team fundraising pages** within **Peer-to-peer settings** on the **Additional Settings** page when you are setting up or editing your fundraiser.  
If you would like your team members to be able to create personal fundraising pages within your team, be sure to enable **Personal fundraising pages within teams**as well.

Within an existing fundraiser's peer to peer settings, the feature is titled**Personal fundraising pages under a team can be created**.

Once enabled, participants will be able to click '**Join this fundraiser → Start a team**'.  
![join this fundraiser.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-team-invite-members/join_this_fundraiser.png)
Step 1: Click 'Join this fundraiser'.  
![start.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-team-invite-members/start.png)
Step 2: Click 'Start a team'.

They will then be prompted to enter their **Team Name** , **Fundraising Goal** , and if desired, they can add their own **image** , **video** , or **text description** , by turning **OFF**these toggle switches:  
![these.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-team-invite-members/these.png)

They will then be prompted to upload an image or video, and enter their own description for the Team page.  
![go.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-team-invite-members/go.png)

Lastly, they will click the **Start a Team** button at the bottom of the page to complete this process.  
![startteam.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-team-invite-members/startteam.png)

## Sharing and Inviting Members to Your Team

**Step 1:** On your team fundraising page, click the 'Share' button above or below the Hero image.  
![sharez.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-team-invite-members/sharez.png)

**Step 2:** This will open the 'Share event' window which includes a link you can copy and share with your network of contacts to send them directly to your team fundraising page.  
![copylink.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-team-invite-members/copylink.png)

**Step 3:** You can also use the social media share options to post the link to Facebook and Twitter Feeds, WhatsApp Chats, LinkedIn Profiles and more. The QR code option and 'Share with other apps' button provide even more flexibility.

Alternatively, you can use your team page's built-in Mailing List (**Manage Fundraiser → Mailing List**).

*** ** * ** ***

Your supporters can simply click "**Join this fundraiser → Join a Team** " to create a their own personal fundraising page within your team (once **Personal fundraising pages within Teams** is enabled).

Each team member will enter their name and personal fundraising goal. If they would like to upload their own image or video, they can simply toggle off the slider for "**Use fundraiser's image and video** ". If they would like to use their own personalized description, they can toggle off "**Use default description text**" and enter their own message.  
If someone does not have the link to your team page but would still like to create a personal page that is linked to your team, they can do so from the main fundraising page by clicking "**Join this fundraiser → Join a Team**".

Your team members can search or simply scroll through the team list to find the team they want to join. After selecting the team they wish to join, they will be prompted to create their own personal fundraising page within that team. (once **Personal fundraising pages within Teams** is enabled).

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/how-to-assign-a-team-manager-co-captain | Nav: How to Assign a Team Manager / Co-Captain | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Assign a Team Manager / Co-Captain

In most cases, the user assigned as Team Captain is the only user who needs access to manage the team fundraising page. However, there are some cases where the team is large enough that the team captain needs assistance managing the team and tracking their progress.

If desired, you have the ability to make the owner of one of the pages within your team the **Team Manager**.

* The Team Manager will be given the same permissions/access as the Team Captain (reports, edit access, etc), but will not be able to delete the team.

* All team email notifications (page joined, donation received, etc) will be sent to the Team Manager as well as the Team Captain.

## How to Assign a Team Manager (as a Team Captain)

To assign a Team Manager for your team, follow the steps below:

1. **Log In** and go to your Team Fundraising Page.

2. Click**Manage my team**in the top right corner.

   ![manageteam.png](../assets/how-to-assign-a-team-manager-co-captain/manageteam.png)
3. Click **Report**on the left sidebar.

4. Scroll down to the **Personal Pages** section and click**Promote to Team Manager** for a team member you would like to make the Team Manager.

   ![teammanager.png](../assets/how-to-assign-a-team-manager-co-captain/teammanager.png)
5. Click **Yes**to confirm.

   ![yeszz.png](../assets/how-to-assign-a-team-manager-co-captain/yeszz.png)

You have the ability to return to this page at any time and demote/change the Team Manager.

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/how-to-cap-number-of-teams-and-number-of-personal- | Nav: How to Cap Number of Teams and Number of Personal Pages Within a Team | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Cap Number of Teams and Number of Personal Pages Within a Team

If desired, you are able to set a maximum number of teams which can be created and you can also cap the number of participants / personal pages within each team.

For example: Say a regional campaign has 8 locations (fundraisers) within one CrowdChange site.

Each location has different capacity and therefore it is necessary to be able to cap the number of teams that can be registered at each location. Additionally, the maximum number of participants within a team must be limited to 6.

This feature allows for both of these limits to be set at the fundraiser or Blueprint level.

## Settings these limits at the Fundraiser Level

To set these limits on your fundraiser, follow the simple steps below:

1. Go to your fundraiser while logged in and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

2. Click on **Peer to Peer Settings**on the left sidebar.

3. Click on **Team Fundraising Pages**.

4. Scroll down to the **Limits**section.

5. Enable **Maximum number of teams that can exist in a fundraiser** and/or a **Limit the number of team members**. Then enter numerical limits for each. For example:

   ![image-20240819-171033.png](../assets/how-to-cap-number-of-teams-and-number-of-personal-/image-20240819-171033.png)
6. Click **Save** to confirm.

   ![image-20240819-171443.png](../assets/how-to-cap-number-of-teams-and-number-of-personal-/image-20240819-171443.png)

## Setting these limits at the Blueprint Level

To set these limits at the Blueprint level, follow the steps below:

1. While logged in to your CrowdChange site, go to **Profile → Admin**.

2. On the left sidebar, click **Blueprints**.

3. Click on the Blueprint you want to edit these limits for.

4. Click **Team Page Settings** on the left sidebar.

   ![teampagesettingsz.png](../assets/how-to-cap-number-of-teams-and-number-of-personal-/teampagesettingsz.png)
5. Enter a **Max. number of teams** and/or a **Maximum number of team members**. For example:

   ![image-20240719-125226.png](../assets/how-to-cap-number-of-teams-and-number-of-personal-/image-20240719-125226.png)
6. Click **Save** to confirm.

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/how-to-hide-a-fundraiser-limit-visibility | Nav: How to Hide a Fundraiser (Limit Visibility) | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Hide a Fundraiser (Limit Visibility)

You have the ability to hide your fundraiser, which prevents it from being seen by the general public.

In this case, it would only be accessible by those with a direct link, as well as Admin users.  
Hidden fundraisers and all Personal/Team pages within them will be hidden within all public APIs and will not be indexed by search engines.

## To Hide a Fundraiser

To hide your fundraiser, simply follow the steps below:

1. **Log In** to your CrowdChange site.

2. Go to your fundraising page and click **Manage Fundraiser** in the top right.

3. Click **Additional settings**on the left sidebar.

4. On the**Additional Settings** page, toggle on **Hidden event**.

   ![image-20240819-172541.png](../assets/how-to-hide-a-fundraiser-limit-visibility/image-20240819-172541.png)
5. Scroll down and click **Save**.

Your fundraiser will then only be accessible by Admins and those with a direct link.

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/how-to-create-custom-urls-for-team-personal-pages- | Nav: How to Create Custom URLs for Team & Personal Pages (Sub-sites only) | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Create Custom URLs for Team & Personal Pages (Sub-sites only)

If you've ever wanted to add that "Signature Touch" to your Team or Personal Fundraising Page, creating a**Custom URL** is a great way to start! Having a link that is memorable and easy for potential donors is a great way to promote your fundraiser.  
Please note that this feature is **not**enabled by default and it is only available on subsites (child sites).

You will need to reach out to your Partner Success Representative to have it enabled on your site.

This feature allows you to create a custom URL for your Team or Personal Page by setting your own suffix.

For example, if I set my suffix to 'jake', and my site is '[mysite.crowdchange.co](http://mysite.crowdchange.co/)', my custom URL will be:

[*mysite.crowdchange.co/page/jake*](http://mysite.crowdchange.co/page/jake)

Please follow these steps to set your custom URL suffix:

1. Go to your Team or Personal Page and **Log In**.

2. Click **Manage my Team (or Manage my Personal Page)** in the upper right-hand corner of the page.

3. Go to **Team (or Page) Settings**on the left sidebar.

4. Enter a custom URL suffix under **Name Your Team Page / Personal Page Link** (Example below).

   ![image-20231026-161421.png](../assets/how-to-create-custom-urls-for-team-personal-pages-/image-20231026-161421.png)  
   ![image-20231026-161331.png](../assets/how-to-create-custom-urls-for-team-personal-pages-/image-20231026-161331.png)

Once successfully saved, you will be ready to share this link with friends and family, or on social media!

Eg: [*mysite.crowdchange.co/page/jake*](http://mysite.crowdchange.co/page/jake)  
Custom Team \& Personal Page URL's will be visible in the following **Admin**Reports:

* Personal Pages Report

* Registration Report

* Teams Report

**This feature is only available on the site where the fundraiser was created. (Sub-sites only)**

For example:

If a fundraiser is created on a sub/child site, the URLs can only be set, and will only work on that site.

They will not work and cannot be changed on the parent site.

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/how-ticketing-works | Nav: How Ticketing Works | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How Ticketing Works

Need to sell tickets? No problem, just turn on our **Fundraiser Tickets** feature!

You can create as many ticket tiers (with variations) as desired, and participants can pay directly online.

Upon purchase confirmation, the donor will receive an email receipt with their tickets attached as a PDF.

To set up tickets within your fundraiser, follow these simple steps:

1. Go to your fundraiser, **Log In** , and then click **Manage Fundraiser**.

   ![managefundraiser.png](../assets/how-ticketing-works/managefundraiser.png)
2. On the left sidebar, click **Purchase Options**.

   ![purchase options.png](../assets/how-ticketing-works/purchase_options.png)
3. On the **Purchase Options** page, click Tickets and toggle the feature on.

   ![ticketsz.png](../assets/how-ticketing-works/ticketsz.png)
4. Click **Save**.

5. To set up your ticket options, scroll down and click **Create Ticket**.

   ![image-20240819-210942.png](../assets/how-ticketing-works/image-20240819-210942.png)
6. Set a **name** , **description** , add **variations** if needed, set a **price** (if desired) and a **limit** (if desired).

   \**All variations will carry the same price.\**

   ![create1.png](../assets/how-ticketing-works/create1.png)
7. Set your desired **availability** for the new ticket tier.

   *\*If desired, you may set a date to automatically close ticket sales.\**

   ![image-20240819-213059.png](../assets/how-ticketing-works/image-20240819-213059.png)
8. Click **Save**when finished.

As the owner of a fundraiser you will have access to all tickets and ticket purchase details within your **Tickets Report** and **Donations Report**. To access these, refer to the articles below:

[How to Access the Donations Report (Fundraiser Level)](https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/How-to-Access-the-Donations-Report-(Fundraiser-Level).2006974566.html)

[How to Access the Tickets Report (Fundraiser Level)](https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/How-to-Access-the-Tickets-Report-(Fundraiser-Level).2006941750.html)  
Donors will receive a **confirmation email** once their purchase is complete.

Please refer to [How Email Templates Work](https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/How-Email-Templates-Work.2013757497.html) when confirming the Automated Trigger Emails within your fundraiser.

================================================================================

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/how-to-use-the-ticket-scanner | Nav: How Ticketing Works > How to Use the Ticket Scanner | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Use the Ticket Scanner

Once you've learned [**How Ticketing Works**](how-ticketing-works.md), you are ready to use the CrowdChange **Ticket Scanner** for your next event!

To enable the **Ticket Scanner** feature on your CrowdChange Fundraiser, follow the steps below:

1. Go to your fundraiser, **Log In** , and then click **Manage Fundraiser**.

   ![managefundraiser.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-ticket-scanner/managefundraiser.png)
2. On the left sidebar, click **Purchase Options**.

   ![purchase options.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-ticket-scanner/purchase_options.png)
3. On the **Purchase Options** page, click Tickets and toggle the feature on.

   ![ticketsz.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-ticket-scanner/ticketsz.png)
4. Additionally, toggle on **Validate tickets with Ticket Scanner**.

   ![validate.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-ticket-scanner/validate.png)
5. Click **Save.**

   ![image-20240820-141326.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-ticket-scanner/image-20240820-141326.png)

## Inviting Ticket Scanners

Once enabled, all tickets will include a unique **QR code** on the PDF ticket.

Follow the steps below to invite **Scanners**and scan tickets at your event:

1. Go to your Fundraiser, and click **Manage Fundraiser**in the upper right-hand corner.

   ![managefundraiser.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-ticket-scanner/managefundraiser.png)
2. On the left sidebar, click **Manage Scanners**.

3. Next, click **Invite Scanner**.

   ![invitescanner.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-ticket-scanner/invitescanner.png)
4. You can enter the name of the staff member/volunteer, and send their invitation by **Email** or **SMS**text.

5. Click **Invite**and the staff member/volunteer will be prompted to access the Ticket Scanner via the link sent to them.

   ![invitescanner2.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-ticket-scanner/invitescanner2.png)
6. On event day, the staff member can now use their phone to scan participant/donor tickets to the event.

## Scanning Tickets

When the mobile user assigned to scan tickets taps the link in the email, they are then given the option to **Scan Tickets**, and when this option is tapped, a camera interface will open with the following options:

1. **Scan QR code**- Simply point the camera at a participant's QR code and tap the circle at the bottom.

2. **Search** - This will open the manual search pop-up (See below - **Manual Verification**).

3. **Upload Image** - In cases where there is an issue with the camera, click**Upload Image** to open your device's file explorer, and upload a picture of the QR Code which can be used for verification:

![IMG_3823.PNG](../assets/how-to-use-the-ticket-scanner/IMG_3823.PNG)

## Manual Verification

If there are issues with either the ticket, the QR code, or if the guest forgets their ticket,**manual search**can be used to verify the ticket and mark it as used.

* You can find a person by name (first name or last name), email, or ticket number.

* Then, simply click on the ticket and select **Tap to Rip.**

* If the ticket was already used, it will still be shown, but you will not be able to mark it as used again.

![IMG_3825.PNG](../assets/how-to-use-the-ticket-scanner/IMG_3825.PNG)  
**Important:** The CrowdChange Ticket Scanner is hosted on our platform and accessed through the browser of a user's mobile device who is given access as a Ticket Scanner.

There is no app to download, or 3rd party hardware to purchase. As long as the mobile device is connected to the internet, you are ready to scan!

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/how-merchandise-works | Nav: How Merchandise Works | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How Merchandise Works

If you're looking to sell **apparel** or **merchandise** for your event, we've got you covered!

You can add as many items (with variations/sizes) as desired, and participants can pay directly online.

Upon completing checkout, the donor will receive an email confirmation of their purchase.  
Please note that CrowdChange **does not** handle shipping and fulfillment of items sold within your fundraiser.

To set up apparel and merchandise within your fundraiser, follow these simple steps:

1. Go to your fundraiser, **Log In** , and then click **Manage Fundraiser**.

   ![managefundraiser.png](../assets/how-merchandise-works/managefundraiser.png)
2. On the left sidebar, click **Purchase Options**.

   ![purchase options.png](../assets/how-merchandise-works/purchase_options.png)
3. On the **Purchase Options** page, click Apparel \& Merchandise and toggle the feature on.

   ![savezzz.png](../assets/how-merchandise-works/savezzz.png)
4. Click **Save**.

5. To add your items, scroll down and click **Create Item.**

   ![image-20240820-153152.png](../assets/how-merchandise-works/image-20240820-153152.png)
6. Set a **name** , **description** , add **variations** if needed (*all variations will carry the same price.)* , set a **price** (if desired), a **limit**(if desired), and add image(s).

   ![image-20240820-153415.png](../assets/how-merchandise-works/image-20240820-153415.png)
7. *For events with registration that includes a T-shirt, you can set the name to "Registration + T-shirt", this allows you to collect sizes from participants who register. For example:*

   ![image-20240820-153742.png](../assets/how-merchandise-works/image-20240820-153742.png)
8. Set your desired **availability** for the new apparel / merchandise item.

   *\*If desired, you may set a date to automatically close sales.\**

   ![image-20240820-153930.png](../assets/how-merchandise-works/image-20240820-153930.png)
9. Click **Save** in the bottom-rightto confirm.

As the fundraiser owner, you will have access to all transaction details and apparel sizes/variations in your **Donations Report**. To access it, refer to the below:

[How to Access the Donations Report (Fundraiser Level)](https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/How-to-Access-the-Donations-Report-(Fundraiser-Level).2006974566.html)  
Donors will receive a **confirmation email** once their purchase is complete.

Please refer to [How Email Templates Work](https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/How-Email-Templates-Work.2013757497.html) when confirming the Automated Trigger Emails within your fundraiser.

# How to Edit Merchandise Items

**Editing** your merchandise for sale is made super easy by following the steps below:

1. Go to your fundraiser, **Log In** , and then click **Manage My Fundraiser**.

   ![image-20250709-170446.png](../assets/how-to-edit-merchandise-items/image-20250709-170446.png)

2. On the left sidebar, click **Purchase Options**.

   ![image-20250709-172658.png](../assets/how-to-edit-merchandise-items/image-20250709-172658.png)

3. On the **Purchase Options** page, click **Apparel \& Merchandise**.

   ![image-20250709-172800.png](../assets/how-to-edit-merchandise-items/image-20250709-172800.png)

4. Scroll down and click on the **Edit**button of an item to make any updates needed.

   ![image-20250715-140846.png](../assets/how-to-edit-merchandise-items/image-20250715-140846.png)

5. Ensure to click **Save**after editing to confirm the changes.

# How to Stop Merchandise Sales

You may **Stop** or **Pause** merchandise sales at any time via the Purchase Options menu.

Follow the steps below to do so:

1. Go to your fundraiser, **Log In** , and then click **Manage My Fundraiser**.

   ![image-20250723-152534.png](../assets/how-to-stop-merchandise-sales/image-20250723-152534.png)

2. On the left sidebar, click **Purchase Options**.

   ![image-20250723-152723.png](../assets/how-to-stop-merchandise-sales/image-20250723-152723.png)

3. On the **Purchase Options** page, click **Apparel \& Merchandise**.

   ![apparel.png](../assets/how-to-stop-merchandise-sales/apparel.png)
4. Scroll down and click on the **Edit**button of an item to make the updates needed.

   ![image-20250723-152934.png](../assets/how-to-stop-merchandise-sales/image-20250723-152934.png)

5. Scroll down to the **Availability** section, and select**Not for sale**.

   ![image-20250723-153040.png](../assets/how-to-stop-merchandise-sales/image-20250723-153040.png)

6. Click the**Save**button at the bottom to confirm.

   ![image-20250723-153113.png](../assets/how-to-stop-merchandise-sales/image-20250723-153113.png)

You **will not** lose historical information of previous sales.

You **will**still be able to accept donations and other purchase options.

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/how-registration-works | Nav: How Registration Works | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How Registration Works

For events where you need to offer **registration**options, whether paid or free, we've made it easy!

You can create as many registration tiers as desired, and participants can pay and register directly online.

All participant information can be downloaded, with one click, right to Excel.  
For peer-to-peer campaigns where registration is **required** to fundraise, click [**here**](how-to-link-registrations-to-personal-team-pages.md) to learn how you can set this up on your CrowdChange site.

To set up simple registration within your fundraiser, follow these steps:

1. Go to your fundraiser, **Log In** , and then click **Manage Fundraiser**.

   ![managefundraiser.png](../assets/how-registration-works/managefundraiser.png)
2. On the left sidebar, click **Purchase Options** .

   ![image-20250728-132839.png](../assets/how-registration-works/image-20250728-132839.png)
3. On the **Purchase Options** page, click **Registration**and toggle the feature on.

   ![registrationz.png](../assets/how-registration-works/registrationz.png)
4. Click **Save**.

5. To begin setting up registration, scroll down and click **Create Registration Tier**.

   ![image-20240820-163128.png](../assets/how-registration-works/image-20240820-163128.png)
6. Set a **name** , **description** , add **variations** if needed, set a **price** (if desired) and a **limit** (if desired).

   \**All variations will carry the same price and be part of the same limit.\**

   ![image-20240820-163342.png](../assets/how-registration-works/image-20240820-163342.png)
7. Set your desired **availability** for the new registration tier.

   *\*If desired, you may set a date to automatically close sales.\**

   ![image-20240820-163647.png](../assets/how-registration-works/image-20240820-163647.png)
8. Click **Save** in the bottom right cornerwhen finished.

As the owner of a fundraiser you will have access to all registrant details in your **Donations Report**. To access it, refer to the below:

[How to Access the Donations Report (Fundraiser Level)](how-to-access-your-fundraiser-s-donations-report.md)  
Donors will receive a **confirmation email** once their purchase is complete.

# How Sponsorship Works (Sponsorship Packages)

Offering **Sponsorship Packages** is a great way to attract large donations to your fundraiser!

You can create as many Sponsorship Packages/Tiers as desired, and participants can pay directly online.

Upon completing checkout, the sponsor will receive email confirmation of their purchase.

See a demo fundraiser with Sponsorship enabled here: [**Demo Fundraiser**](https://charitiesknowledgebase.crowdchange.dev/13986)

Follow these simple steps to set up sponsorship on your fundraiser:

1. Go to your fundraiser, **Log In** , and then click **Manage Fundraiser**.

   ![managefundraiser.png](../assets/how-sponsorship-works-sponsorship-packages/managefundraiser.png)
2. On the left sidebar, click **Purchase Options**.

   ![purchase options.png](../assets/how-sponsorship-works-sponsorship-packages/purchase_options.png)
3. On the **Purchase Options** page, click **Sponsorship Packages**and toggle the feature on.

   ![sponsorships.png](../assets/how-sponsorship-works-sponsorship-packages/sponsorships.png)
4. Click **Save**.

5. To begin setting up your sponsorship packages, scroll down and click **Create sponsorship package.**

   ![image-20240820-171013.png](../assets/how-sponsorship-works-sponsorship-packages/image-20240820-171013.png)
6. Set a **name** , **description** , **price** (if desired) and a **limit**(if desired).

   ![image-20240820-171221.png](../assets/how-sponsorship-works-sponsorship-packages/image-20240820-171221.png)
7. Scroll down and select your desired **availability** for the new sponsorship package.

   *\*If desired, you may set a date to automatically close sales.\**

   ![image-20240820-171426.png](../assets/how-sponsorship-works-sponsorship-packages/image-20240820-171426.png)
8. Click **Save**in the bottom right to confirm.

As the owner of a fundraiser you will have access to all sponsor details in your **Donations Report** . See the following article \& video on how to access it: [How to Access the Donations Report (Fundraiser Level)](how-to-access-your-fundraiser-s-donations-report.md)  
Sponsors will receive a **receipt / confirmation email** once their purchase is complete.

# How to Use Custom Questions

The **Custom Questions** feature is a great way for you to collect specific information you need from your donors, guests or participants! It allows you to collect information in the form of a **Text Box** , **Dropdown Menu** , or **Checkboxes** . This feature also allows you to attach a **Waiver** to your fundraiser.  
**Custom Questions** are a great way for your fundraising team to collect additional data points about your donors. Looking to find out if a social media campaign for your fundraiser was successful?

Ask your donors! - "*How did you hear about us?"*is one of the most commonly used, and effective examples of a custom checkout question for existing CrowdChange partners.

**Custom Questions** can be toggled on from the **Purchase Options**section when creating a fundraiser.  
![image-20250723-154920.png](../assets/how-to-use-custom-questions/image-20250723-154920.png)

Once your fundraiser is created, click**Manage My Fundraiser** in the upper right-hand corner of the page.  
![image-20250723-154955.png](../assets/how-to-use-custom-questions/image-20250723-154955.png)

Then go to **Custom Questions** on the left sidebar.  
![image-20250723-155330.png](../assets/how-to-use-custom-questions/image-20250723-155330.png)

From the **Custom Questions** page, click **Add** **Question** under **Questions** to create your first one.  
![image-20250723-155618.png](../assets/how-to-use-custom-questions/image-20250723-155618.png)  
![image-20250723-160524.png](../assets/how-to-use-custom-questions/image-20250723-160524.png)

Click **Save** in the bottom right corner to confirm.  
If you require the ability to set**Custom ID's** for each question (as shown in the image above), reach out to your Partner Success Representative for this feature to be enabled on your site.

*** ** * ** ***

The available types of Custom Questions are as follows:

* **Text**

  * The **Text** option allows users to enter specific information in response to a question you ask.

    Within the **Text** option, you may select a format: **Freeform text** , **Phone number** , **Date** or **Number**.

* **Checkboxes**

  * The **Checkboxes**option allows users to select from a pre-determined list of answers to your question, which can include the selection of multiple answers.

* **Dropdown**

  * The **Dropdown**option allows users to select an answer to your question from a list that you have determined. In this situation, users are only able to select one option.

* **Waiver**

  * If your event requires a **Waiver**that your participants must agree to, this function allows you to insert the content of your waiver into a box that the user will be prompted to view and agree to.

* **Multi-Line Text**

  * The **Multi-Line Text**option works the same way as the standard Text Box \> Freeform Text option, but allows for more detailed information to be entered via multi-line functionality.

Toggling on the **Mark as Required** checkbox means that users must answer this custom question in order to complete their purchase or donation. This is highly recommended for an event where, for example, a waiver is required for persons to participate.

The '**Show this field on**' section allows you to determine on which pages (General Donations, Team Pages, and/or Personal Pages) the question is presented to the donor.  
![image-20250723-160737.png](../assets/how-to-use-custom-questions/image-20250723-160737.png)

The '**Show this field when these options are selected**' section helps to specify even further, in what circumstances the question will show up.

For example, you can ensure that your question is always asked to those who are purchasing tickets, but not to those who are simply donating. This is helpful if you are asking questions specific to one or some of the features you have decided to use.  
![image-20250723-160808.png](../assets/how-to-use-custom-questions/image-20250723-160808.png)  
Note that answers to questions which are set to '**Repeat for each registrant** ' will appear in the Excel version of the[**Registration Report**](https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/How-to-Access-the-Registrations-Report.2022834323.html). Within this report, go to your fundraiser's specific tab (named: Fundraiser ID - Fundraiser Name), and scroll all the way to the right, to the last columns.

Answers to regular custom checkout questions will appear within the [**Admin Donations Report**](https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/How-to-Access-the-Admin-Donations-Report.2025226327.html?t=lsmx9P7KHk1WU6-3G11a4w).

## **Conditional Questions**

CrowdChange offers the ability to ask **Conditional Questions** at check-out.

There are two (2) types of Conditional Questions:

* Those which will only show up if a certain answer is given to a previous question.

  * For example, a question like '*Rare, Medium Rare or Well-Done?* ' could appear after the response '*Steak* ' is given for '*What is your preferred meal option?*'.

* Those which will only show up if specific Purchase options are added to the cart.

  * For example, the question '*What size are you?*' could be asked when a T-shirt purchase option is added to the cart, and registrants could be asked specific sets of custom questions depending on the registration option they select (E.g. Youth vs. Adult vs. Senior registration).

### To create a conditional question linked to a specific answer to a previous question:

Start by creating both questions you would like your donors to answer - the **Parent** question, and the **Child** question. The Parent question must be either a **Single Selection** or **Multiple Choice** question - it cannot be a **Text** or **Waiver**question. You can set the Child question to appear only if a specific answer is given to the Parent question. Please follow the steps below to set this up:

1. Create both the Parent and Child question.

2. Ensure that these questions are set to appear on the same pages (In the '*Show this field on* ' section), and with the same purchase options (In the '*Show this field when these options are selected*' section).

3. On the Child question, toggle on **Set Conditions**.

4. Within the **Type** dropdown that appears, select **Custom question** . From here, within the **Field name** dropdown, you can select the (Parent) question which the Child question should be linked to, and use the **Answer**dropdown to set which answer(s) should cause the Child question to appear.

5. Be sure to click **Save**when you are finished.

![setconditions.png](../assets/how-to-use-custom-questions/setconditions.png)

### To create a conditional question linked to specific purchase options being added to cart:

In this scenario there is no need for a Parent and Child question. Simply add the desired purchase options to your fundraiser and go to **Manage Fundraiser → Custom Questions**to create your questions.

Follow the simple steps below to set this up:

1. Ensure your desired purchase options have been created at the fundraiser level.

2. Go to **Manage Fundraiser → Custom Questions**.

3. Click **Add Question**.

4. Enter the required information and click **Set conditions**.

5. Within the **Type** dropdown that appears, select **Purchase options** . From here, within the **Select option** dropdown, you can select the type/category of purchase option you are looking for, then the specific option(s) within the dropdown on the right.

6. Be sure to click **Save**when you are finished.

![options23.png](../assets/how-to-use-custom-questions/options23.png)

# How to Edit Answers to Custom Questions on user request (Multi-Registration sites only)

**N.B.**This feature only applies for transactions made to fundraisers with our multi-registration flow.

If a donor or registrant makes a mistake while answering your custom checkout questions, or simply changes their mind, don't worry! You have the ability as an Admin user to make the adjustments in CrowdChange.

From the Admin Registration Report, each registration listed will have a **Change** button in the rightmost column, which you can click on to adjust answers to custom checkout questions. You may also adjust registrant **name** ('username' in Admin Reports),**display name** (in public Donation Lists), edit any displayed **comment** and set whether to show or hide the transaction **amount**.

Follow these simple steps to change answers to custom questions:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click **Profile** in in the top right corner, then**Admin**.

3. Go to **Reports** **\> Registration Report**using the left sidebar.

4. Click the **Change**button next to a registration.

   ![299307.png](../assets/how-to-edit-answers-to-custom-questions-on-user-re/299307.png)
5. Scroll down to the custom checkout questions (last in the list) and make your desired adjustments.

6. Click **Save**to confirm your changes.

   ![edit2.png](../assets/how-to-edit-answers-to-custom-questions-on-user-re/edit2.png)

# How to Use the Access Manager - Give others Admin Access for an Event (Fundraiser Level)

You can use your fundraiser's **Access Manager** to set administrative permissions for new or existing users. This is especially useful when you need to give **Edit** or **Reports Access** to a new user who does not have an existing CrowdChange account.

Once the desired permissions have been set, an invitation email will be sent to the new user, who will be prompted to create an account and accept the permissions.

To utilize this feature, click **ManageMy Fundraiser** , then**Access Manager** on the left sidebar.  
![image-20250723-181039.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-access-manager-give-others-admin-ac/image-20250723-181039.png)  
![image-20250723-181216.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-access-manager-give-others-admin-ac/image-20250723-181216.png)

On the Access Manager page, you can **give** , **edit** and **remove**custom access.

When users are given access, they will be listed and edit / remove controls will be shown.  
Please note that users you give access to using Access Manager will **not** receive **Fundraiser Notification Emails**. Currently, these are only sent to the Fundraiser Owner, and site-wide Admins.

## To Give Access

1. Click **Add Account**.

2. Enter the new or existing user's email and click **Continue**.

   1. If the user already exists in our system, you will see the name of the user.

   2. If the user does not yet exist, you will need to enter their first and last name.

3. Click the checkbox or toggle next to all permissions you desire the user to have, or click **Full Access**.

   ![image-20250723-181618.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-access-manager-give-others-admin-ac/image-20250723-181618.png)

4. Click **Send Invite**in the bottom-right corner when ready.

### To Edit Access

1. Click the cog / gear icon next to the user you want to edit.

2. Click **Edit**.

   ![editaccess.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-access-manager-give-others-admin-ac/editaccess.png)
3. Change permissions as desired and click **Save**.

### To Remove Access

1. Click the cog / gear icon next to the user you want to remove.

2. Click **Remove Access**.

   ![remove22.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-access-manager-give-others-admin-ac/remove22.png)
3. Click **Remove access**

   ![image-20250805-170707.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-access-manager-give-others-admin-ac/image-20250805-170707.png)

If your invitation is pending, you will instead see the option to **resend** , or **cancel**it.

# How to Duplicate a Fundraiser

**Duplicating**can save you a lot of time when setting up a new fundraiser. Instead of having to start from scratch, you can use a previously created fundraiser as a template to get started.

To duplicate a fundraiser, follow these steps:

1. Go to the fundraiser you would like to duplicate and **Log In**.

2. Click **Manage Fundraiser** in the top right corner of the page.

   ![image-20240820-191940.png](../assets/how-to-duplicate-a-fundraiser/image-20240820-191940.png)
3. Click the **triple-dot icon** in the top right corner, then **Duplicate Fundraiser**.

   ![image-20240820-192954.png](../assets/how-to-duplicate-a-fundraiser/image-20240820-192954.png)
4. Enter a New Fundraiser Name, select what features to include and click **Create New Fundraiser**.

   ![image-20240820-193037.png](../assets/how-to-duplicate-a-fundraiser/image-20240820-193037.png)

**Important Notes:**

Duplicating a fundraiser will not carry over any historical data (transaction details, donor information, etc.). Our recommendation is to download the**Donations Report** from the original fundraiser, as the donor contact information can then be imported to the **Mailing List** of the new fundraiser.

Please refer to the below:

* **How to Access the Donations Report**

* [How to Use the Mailing List](how-to-use-the-mailing-list.md)
Duplicated fundraisers will enter **Fundraiser Approval**, and will need to be approved.

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/recurring-donations | Nav: Recurring Donations | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Recurring Donations

To get started with **Recurring Donations**, check out the steps below to learn how to do the following:

* Enable Recurring Donations on a Fundraiser and set the default donation type

* Edit Automated Email Templates connected to Recurring Donations

* Access your Profile to edit your Recurring Donations

Admin users can set a minimum amount for Recurring Donations via [**Admin → General Settings**](https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/Admin-%3E-General-Settings.2006614017.html).

They also have access to the **Recurring Donations Report** within **Admin → Reports**.

For more information, please see [**How to Access the Recurring Donations Report**](https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/How-to-Access-the-Recurring-Donations-Report.2037448799.html?t=lsmx9P7KHk1WU6-3G11a4w).

## Note on Tax Receipts for Recurring Donations

**Please note** that **Tax Receipts** for recurring donations are generated at year-end (First week of January of the following year) and are populated in your **Tax Receipts Report**automatically. All recurring donations for the year are consolidated into one tax receipt. These will show as 'Annual'.

## Getting Started with Recurring Donations

### Enable Recurring Donations on a Fundraiser and set the default donation type

1. From your fundraiser, click **Manage Fundraiser** , then**Donation Settings**.

   ![managefundraiserpls.png](../assets/recurring-donations/managefundraiserpls.png)  
   ![donation settings.png](../assets/recurring-donations/donation_settings.png)
2. Click **Donation amounts \& types**as shown above.

3. Enable **Accept Recurring Donations** , then specify your **Accepted Donation Types** , **Default Donation Type** , and **Minimum Recurring Donation Amount**. For example:

   ![image-20231028-180709.png](../assets/recurring-donations/image-20231028-180709.png)
4. ***Optional*** *- if desired, you can also set default donation amounts and impact statements for each type of donation you have enabled. To set monthly and annual donation amounts, scroll down to this section:*

   ![image-20231028-181106.png](../assets/recurring-donations/image-20231028-181106.png)
5. At the bottom of the page, click **Save** to confirm.

### Edit Automated Email Templates connected to Recurring Donations

1. From your fundraiser, go to **Manage Fundraiser →** **Automated Email Templates**.

2. Click on any template you want to edit and toggle on**I want to use my own text**.

   ![recurringdonationreceipt.png](../assets/recurring-donations/recurringdonationreceipt.png)
3. Edit the subject and message body as desired and click **Save**.

4. *Optional: You can send yourself a* ***Preview Email*** *or* ***Reset*** *the message to default by clicking the respective buttons.*

### Access your Profile to update your Recurring Donations

1. From anywhere on your CrowdChange site, click **Profile** in in the top right, then**My Profile**

2. Select**My Recurring Donations** from the left sidebar.

3. For any recurring donation in the list, you can perform the following actions:

   1. **Change Amount** *- Note that if a minimum recurring donation amount is set at the Admin \> General Settings level, you are not able to set the amount lower than this number.*

   2. **Change Payment Day**

   3. **Skip Next Payment**

   4. **Pause \& Resume Recurring Donation**

   5. **Cancel Recurring Donation**

      ![image-20240821-163917.png](/__attachments/a_40752c2a5713463d9aaa7b11b31abb877023b85d63fdf36f2e70e8027cb4787f/image-20240821-163917.png?cb=7573ac5f05bce8f122a26964699efbea)
4. To update your payment method (credit / debit card), click the pencil icon next to the last 4 digits of your card number at the top of the recurring donation. Enter the new details and click **Save**to confirm.

If you would like to receive email notification for every recurring donation charge, you can enable this from **Profile \> Notifications \> General Notifications**

## If a Recurring Donation Fails...

In cases where a Recurring Donation fails (for example: credit card has expired or amount exceeds limit), we will try to process the transaction again at a later date according to this timeline:

* **1st Failure** → Notification email is sent to donor and Admin, advising that the charge failed and why. Retry in 3 days is scheduled.

* **2nd Failure** → Retry in 7 days is scheduled.

* **3rd Failure** → Retry in 7 days is scheduled.

* **4th Failure** → Retry in 7 days is scheduled.

* **If Rety 4 fails** , Recurring Donation is *Paused* - email notification will be sent to the donor stating that this donation has been paused, and that it can be resumed via the **Profile** section.

# How to Cancel a Recurring Donation

This article and video will show you how to cancel any recurring donation you've made through CrowdChange. To do so, follow these steps:

1. From your CrowdChange site, click **Profile** in the top-right corner, then **My Profile**.

   ![profile.png](../assets/how-to-cancel-a-recurring-donation/profile.png)
2. Click **My Recurring Donations** on the left sidebar.

3. Click the **Cancel Recurring Donation**button next to the recurring donation you'd like to cancel.

You also have the option of **Pausing** your recurring donation, or **Skipping** the next scheduled payment, without canceling your subscription entirely, and you can also change the **Amount** or **Payment Day** using the respective buttons. If you'd just like to **Update** your **Payment Method / Credit Card** , click on the **pencil**icon next to the expiry date of your card shown in screenshot below.  
![myrecurring.png](../assets/how-to-cancel-a-recurring-donation/myrecurring.png)
