# How to Use the Mailing List

You can use our **Mailing List** feature to send out email fundraising campaigns, or just to send a personalized thank you to your donors!

It's a great way to keep supporters up to date and engaged with your fundraiser, team or personal page.

To get started, follow the simple steps below!

1. From your fundraiser, click **Manage Fundraiser** in the top right corner, then **Mailing List** .

   (*On a personal page or team, go to* ***Manage my page/team → Mailing List*** *in the top right).*

   ![image-20250805-180643.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/image-20250805-180643.png)

   ![image-20250805-180737.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/image-20250805-180737.png)

2. You will then be taken to the Mailing List main page, where you have three options:

   *You may also return here at any time to view information and reports on sent emails.*

   ![image-20250805-181020.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/image-20250805-181020.png)

   1. **Contacts**- From here you can add to and manage your contact list. You may add contacts manually or import them from a CSV file. Donors to your fundraiser/team/page will be added automatically. Team Captains on your fundraiser will be added automatically.

   2. **Templates**- From here you can create and manage your email templates. For detailed tutorials on using email templates, check out the following articles:

      1. **How to Create a Custom Email Template**

      2. **How to Edit a Pre-existing Email Template**

      3. **How Email Templates Work**

   3. **Send email** - This is where you will go to send out emails (campaigns).

3. To send out your first email campaign, click on **Send Email**.

   ![image-20250805-181227.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/image-20250805-181227.png)

4. Click **Choose Recipients** within the **To**field and select all contacts you'd like to send to.

   ![image-20250805-181300.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/image-20250805-181300.png)

5. Click the**Add Recipients** button in the bottom right.

   Note that you can use the dropdown in the top left corner to view these lists:**Imported Contacts** , **Donors** ,**Previous Donors** and **Team Captains**. The latter three are automatically stored as contacts.

   ![image-20250805-181400.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/image-20250805-181400.png)

6. Add and verify your email address in the **From** field. *If you are adding yourself as sender for the first time, CrowdChange will send a verification code to your email to confirm your identity. When you receive the email verification code, copy \& paste the code into CrowdChange and click* ***Verify*** *. If you do not receive a verification email, click* ***resend verification code*** *.*

   ![image-20250805-182339.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/image-20250805-182339.png)

7. If you would like to use an email template you added previously, select it under **Select email template**.

   ![image-20250805-182412.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/image-20250805-182412.png)

8. Fill out your **Subject** and **Message** fields, using the **Dynamic Tags** feature to have certain information automatically pulled in when sending a campaign to multiple recipients. This allows you to send **one** email to **multiple** recipients, rather than sending many one-recipient emails, and having to enter data like this each time: *Recipient First Name \& Last Name, Fundraiser Raised Amount, Link to Fundraiser.* See further examples in screenshot below. For more info, see **How Email Templates Work**.

   ![dynamic tags.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/dynamic_tags.png)
9. Check the '**Save this message as a template for future use** ' field if desired, and complete the **reCAPTCHA**verification.

   ![eg34.png](../assets/how-to-use-the-mailing-list/eg34.png)
10. If you'd like, you can send yourself a preview email before sending out the email campaign. Simply click the '**Send preview email**' button to do so.

    ![sendpreview.png](/__attachments/a_f437caef65224b5da64748d16f3a8b36cdcd016e8eaac4a49789137eb4e8849f/sendpreview.png?cb=aad80e1746281508d39ae010872781b9)
11. When you are ready, click on the **Send**button to send out your email campaign.

    ![saveeeeeeee.png](/__attachments/a_616f785e84a5c10072608c255e763cbc35473e48315963bdee737b29c8ce2433/saveeeeeeee.png?cb=e37b190da3182f4aa68dde2e8bfbcd89)

# How to Create a Custom Email Template

You can save a lot of time sending email campaigns by creating **custom templates** within the Mailing List!  
See also: **How to Use the Mailing List**

Follow these simple steps below to create a custom email template:

1. From your fundraising page, click **Manage Fundraiser**.

   ![managefundraiserzz.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-custom-email-template/managefundraiserzz.png)
2. On the left sidebar, click**Mailing List**.

   ![mailingliss.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-custom-email-template/mailingliss.png)
3. Click **Templates** , then **Create New Template**.

   ![templates1.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-custom-email-template/templates1.png)

   ![createnewtemplate.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-custom-email-template/createnewtemplate.png)
4. Set a **Template Name** , **Subject** , **Message Body** , and add any desired **Dynamic Tags**. For example:

   ![tagsz.png](../assets/how-to-create-a-custom-email-template/tagsz.png)
5. *Optional: Click* ***Send Preview Email*** *to get a preview.*

6. Click **Save**to save the template.

# How to Edit a Pre-existing Email Template

To **edit** an email template you've already created, it's super easy!

This article covers how to edit your existing email templates within our **Mailing List** feature.  
See also: **How to Use the Mailing List**

To edit an existing email template, follow the steps below:

1. From your fundraising page, click **Manage Fundraiser**.

   ![managefundraiserzz.png](../assets/how-to-edit-a-pre-existing-email-template/managefundraiserzz.png)
2. On the left sidebar, click**Mailing List**.

   ![mailingliss.png](../assets/how-to-edit-a-pre-existing-email-template/mailingliss.png)
3. Click **Templates**.

   ![templates1.png](../assets/how-to-edit-a-pre-existing-email-template/templates1.png)
4. Click **Edit**to the right of the template you would like to adjust.

   ![thanksedit.png](../assets/how-to-edit-a-pre-existing-email-template/thanksedit.png)
5. Edit **Template Name** , **Subject** , **Message Body** , and **Dynamic Tags** as desired.

6. *Optional: Click* ***Send Preview Email*** *to get a preview.*

7. Click **Save**to save the changes to this template.

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/how-to-enter-offline-donations | Nav: How to Enter Offline Donations | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Enter Offline Donations

You can use our **Offline Donations** feature to:

* Add donations you've received outside of CrowdChange to your Total Amount Raised and Donor List

* Pay a donation on behalf of a donor, with them receiving a Tax Receipt in their name

* Facilitate [**Pledging**](https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/How-Pledging-Works.2086600705.html?t=lsmx9P7KHk1WU6-3G11a4w)and send donors a direct Payment link via Email or SMS

To add in an Offline Donation, follow these steps:

1. Go to the fundraising page (or Personal / Team Page) you would like to add the donation to.

2. Click **Manage Fundraiser** (on fundraisers) then go to **Offline donations** on the left sidebar.

   ![image-20250715-185746.png](../assets/how-to-enter-offline-donations/image-20250715-185746.png)  
   ![image-20250715-182725.png](../assets/how-to-enter-offline-donations/image-20250715-182725.png)

3. On Personal / Team pages, click**Manage my page (or team)→ Offline donations**.

   ![image-20250715-191146.png](../assets/how-to-enter-offline-donations/image-20250715-191146.png)

4. Click **Add Donation** and fill out the required fields. **Please note**the following:

   1. *If desired, you can email a payment link by entering an email and clicking the '* ***Send link for individual or group to make online payment*** *'* *checkbox. If you would like to send a payment link via SMS instead of email, leave this checkbox* ***unchecked*** *- once the donation has been added, you will be able to click* ***Share Payment Link*** *and send to your desired phone number.*

   2. *If you select '* ***This is a Lump Sum Donation*** *', you will* ***not*** *be required to enter any Billing Information, and* ***no*** *Tax Receipt will be issued.*

      ![image-20230714-134010.png](/__attachments/a_30a15a0cbc6f3744f65ac817cccb31026c77ac72ab9518ad1595387435b83f16/image-20230714-134010.png?cb=5df54268ecd999e074fdb6e42c7305b7)
   3. *If you require a tax receipt for this donation, click '* ***Request tax receipt for this donation*** *' and enter the billing address of the donor for tax receipt.*

   4. *To assign this donation to a team, indicate the payment method and date of donation, set a donation display name, write a public comment, show/hide the donation amount, and/or add any internal notes about this donation, click '* ***Show advanced settings*** *' under '* ***Additional Information*** *'.*

   5. *If you select* ***Mark as Received*** *under '* ***Transaction Status*** *', the donation will be confirmed and shown in CrowdChange Donations Reports. This will be done automatically if online payment is received.*

      ![image-20250715-203324.png](/__attachments/a_d12a13e09d798a542347b97c1ce560c89db5f8e9378e40b2a846a79ba368d53e/image-20250715-203324.png?cb=5df160ade420eccad57a8fc0eca60b37)

5. Once you have added the information as desired, click **Save**at the bottom of the page.

   ![image-20250716-143925.png](../assets/how-to-enter-offline-donations/image-20250716-143925.png)

6. You can return to the Offline Donations menu at any time to **view** , **update** or **delete** donations entered.

   ![image-20250716-174904.png](../assets/how-to-enter-offline-donations/image-20250716-174904.png)

Offline Donations will only be shown in our Donations Reports once they have been **paid/received**.

However, Offline Donations **will be** included in Total Raised bar amounts while in **Pending**.

Only admins and the host of a fundraiser have the option to **Mark As Received**.

If desired, you can send donors a **Payment Link** for them to pay a pending donation themselves. Just click the triple dot icon next to the donation you'd like them to pay and select **Share Payment Link.**

## To make a donation on behalf of someone else

1. Go to**Manage Fundraiser → Offline Donations** (Personal / Team pages:**Manage my page (or team) → Offline donations**).

2. Click **Add Donation** and enter the donor's details. Enter **Tax Receipt Information** if necessary.

3. Under**Additional Information → Show Advanced Settings** , select **Credit Card** as Payment Method.

4. Once you have added all relevant information, click **Save**at the bottom of the page.

5. Click **Pay Now** next to the pending donation to pay for the donation using your own Credit Card \& Billing info. The tax receipt will still be issued in the donor's name and address (entered in Step 2).

## To issue a tax receipt after an offline donation has been entered

1. Go to**Manage Fundraiser → Offline Donations** (Personal / Team pages:**Manage my page (or team)→ Offline donations**).

2. Find the donation you would like to issue a Tax Receipt for and click the **triple dot icon** next to it.

3. Click **Issue Tax Receipt**.

4. Fill out all necessary information and click **Issue**.

This will only be an option for donations that have been **Paid** or **Marked as Received**.

If you want to re-issue a tax receipt for an offline donation, follow the same steps, but you will select **Re-Issue Tax Receipt** instead.

# Custom Questions for Teams & Personal Pages

Need to gather specific information from Team Captains or Personal Page creators? You're bound to love our custom questions feature for Teams \& Personal Pages!

Using it, you can create questions (including conditional questions), which are asked when someone is creating a team or personal page, via our simplified peer-to-peer, or multi-registration workflows.  
Please note that this feature is **NOT**enabled by default.

Reach out to your Partner Success Representative today to explore how this functionality could benefit your campaign!

See instructions below for how to set up Team and Personal Page Questions:
Setting up Team Questions  

## Setting up Team Questions

1. On a fundraiser where Team Fundraising Pages are enabled, click**Manage Fundraiser** , then**Peer to Peer settings** on the left sidebar.

2. Click **Team Fundraising Pages** and scroll down to **Custom Questions**.

3. Click **Add Question** to create a custom team question.

   ![add qu.png](../assets/custom-questions-for-teams-personal-pages/add_qu.png)
4. Select your question **Type** (Text, Checkboxes, Dropdown, Waiver or Multi-line text), sub-type (if applicable), fill out the details of your question, and click **Save** when finished.

   ![SAVEZZZZ.png](../assets/custom-questions-for-teams-personal-pages/SAVEZZZZ.png)
5. Add in as many questions as needed (optional, conditional or required), ensuring to **Save**.

6. When creating a new team, creators/captains will be asked the custom questions.

   1. During the normal "Start a Team" process:

      ![phonenum.png](/__attachments/a_fba178b3cda755af83647fe22216e60e78316548fe52fbe6ef19c476a1461fe6/phonenum.png?cb=d9d347a56308224e5d8ee6ef4ec67bdf)
   2. During the multi-registration team creation process:

      ![phonenumber.png](/__attachments/a_fbd38e17ce1060b6a1b76c94eef9a2cf0a142c911f3c3db180cf5d7537175518/phonenumber.png?cb=6acb6995920c1761b38d7350586d9323)
Setting up Personal Page Questions  

## Setting up Personal Page Questions

1. On a fundraiser where Personal Fundraising Pages are enabled, click**Manage Fundraiser** , then**Peer to Peer settings** on the left sidebar.

2. Click **Personal Fundraising Pages** and scroll down to **Custom Questions**.

3. Click **Add Question** to create a custom personal page question.

   ![addqu2.png](../assets/custom-questions-for-teams-personal-pages/addqu2.png)
4. Select your question **Type** (Text, Checkboxes, Dropdown, Waiver or Multi-line text), sub-type (if applicable), fill out the details of your question, and click **Save** when finished.

   ![SAVEZZZZ.png](../assets/custom-questions-for-teams-personal-pages/SAVEZZZZ.png)
5. Add in as many questions as needed (optional, conditional or required), ensuring to **Save**.

6. When creating a new personal page, creators will be asked the custom questions during the normal (non multi-reg) "Start a Fundraising Page" process:

   ![phonenum4.png](../assets/custom-questions-for-teams-personal-pages/phonenum4.png)

## **Conditional Questions**

You can also ask **Conditional Questions** within your Team and Personal Page Custom Questions.

These are questions which will only show up if a certain condition is met relating to a previous question.

For example, a question like '*What is your team's registration number?* ' could appear after the response '*Yes* ' is given for '*Is your team registered with X organization?*'.

To set this up, you will create both questions you would like your donors to answer (following the instructions above) - the Parent question, and the Child question.

The Parent question must be either a **Single Selection** or **Multiple Choice** question - it cannot be a **Text** or **Waiver**question. See example parent question below:  
![parent1.png](../assets/custom-questions-for-teams-personal-pages/parent1.png)

Now you can create the Child question and set it to appear only if a specific answer is given to the Parent question. To do so, once you've created it, toggle on **Set Conditions**.

Here you can select the (Parent) question which the Child question should be linked to, and determine what answers should cause the Child question to appear. See example below:  
![child1.png](../assets/custom-questions-for-teams-personal-pages/child1.png)

Be sure to click **Save** in the bottom right when you are finished.

## Additional Information

The answers to these questions will be visible in the Admin **Teams Report** and **Personal Pages Report**.

Additionally, the answers to these questions are editable from the **Manage my Team** / **Manage my Page** → **Team Settings / Page Settings** menus at any time.

If using **Blueprints**, you will have the ability to set these questions at the blueprint level and apply to all connected fundraisers.  
If you require the ability to set**Custom ID's** for each question, reach out to your Partner Success Representative for this feature to be enabled on your site.

================================================================================

# How to Set Up Promo Codes

Do you want to offer special discounts to certain donor groups? CrowdChange includes powerful Promo Codes functionality. There are 2 types of Promo Codes you can create: **Flat Discount** , and **Special Pricing**.  
Promo Codes can be applied to **Tickets** , **Merchandise** and/or **Registrations**.

## Step 1: Enable Promo Codes on your Fundraiser

The first step is to enable the Promo Codes feature within your fundraiser settings. To do so, from your main fundraising page, click **Manage Fundraiser** , then **Purchase Options**on the left sidebar.

On the **Purchase Options** page, scroll down to **Additional Features** and click **Promo Codes**.  
![promocodes.png](../assets/how-to-set-up-promo-codes/promocodes.png)

Enable the **Promo Codes** toggle and click **Save**.  
![image-20240820-173113.png](../assets/how-to-set-up-promo-codes/image-20240820-173113.png)

## Step 2: Create a Promo Code

To create a Promo Code, scroll down and click **Add promo code**.  
![image-20240820-173245.png](../assets/how-to-set-up-promo-codes/image-20240820-173245.png)

Select either **Flat Discount** or **Custom Pricing** (see description below).  
![image-20240820-173332.png](../assets/how-to-set-up-promo-codes/image-20240820-173332.png)

*** ** * ** ***

### **Flat Discount**

Allows you to offer a discount of a specific dollar value or percentage, applied to some, or all items.

In the example below, a 50% discount applies for All Tickets and 2 out of 3 Registrations, but no Apparel / Merchandise.

At the bottom you will see that this Promo Code has been limited to a quantity of 5, and will expire on the date set.

![image-20240820-173836.png](../assets/how-to-set-up-promo-codes/image-20240820-173836.png)  
![image-20240820-173855.png](../assets/how-to-set-up-promo-codes/image-20240820-173855.png)  
![image-20240820-173919.png](../assets/how-to-set-up-promo-codes/image-20240820-173919.png)  

### **Custom Pricing**

Allows you to set custom prices for all items, or specific Tickets, Registrations, and Apparel options, selectable via the dropdown menu.

In the example below, the Corporate Registration - Individual option is priced at $110, instead of $210, with the use of this Promo Code, and the "JakeTest" option is free instead of $100.

Limit and Expiration date have also been set.  
![image-20240820-174142.png](../assets/how-to-set-up-promo-codes/image-20240820-174142.png)  
![image-20240820-174114.png](../assets/how-to-set-up-promo-codes/image-20240820-174114.png)

*** ** * ** ***

3. Once you've set up your Promo Code as desired, click the **Save**button at the bottom.

![saveeeeeee.png](../assets/how-to-set-up-promo-codes/saveeeeeee.png)

4. On the Promo Codes page as shown below, you will be able at any time to **Edit** , **Delete** , **De-Activate** , or **Re-Activate** your created Promo Codes.

Unknown Attachment

You can return here at any time from **Manage Fundraiser → Purchase Options → Promo Codes**.

## How to Use Promo Codes at Checkout

Using a Promo Code at checkout is super simple! Simply look for the **Summary** box and enter your code under '**Have Promo Code?** '. Click the arrowand your discounts will be applied.  
Please note that only **one** Promo Code can be applied at a time.  

Unknown Attachment  

Unknown Attachment  
To **Remove** the Promo Code, click the**trash can** icon above, next to '**Promo code applied'**.

# How to Create an eCards Store

In this tutorial, you will learn how to create your first **eCards Store**! eCards are an awesome, easy-to-use feature of CrowdChange which brings added value and engagement to your online fundraising portal.  
eCards can be sent via Email, postal Mail or SMS.  
![image-20231123-181300.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20231123-181300.png)

## How to Enable eCards when creating your fundraiser

To create an eCards store, you must first enable the eCards feature on a fundraiser - you can do so while creating (or editing) a fundraiser. Here are the steps to enable eCards while creating a fundraiser.

1. From the homepage of your CrowdChange site, click**Start a Fundraiser**in the top right corner.

   ![image-20231123-152708.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20231123-152708.png)
2. Fill out all necessary information about your fundraiser on the **General Info** page.

   ![image-20231123-152830.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20231123-152830.png)
3. Scroll down and click **Next** to continue to the **Additional Settings**page.

   ![nxt.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/nxt.png)
4. On the **Additional Settings** page, enable **eCards** under **Advanced Features**.

   ![image-20231123-153512.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20231123-153512.png)
5. Scroll down and click **Create Fundraiser**.

   ![image-20231123-153544.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20231123-153544.png)

## How to Set Up eCards on your fundraiser

Once eCards is enabled on your fundraiser, the next step is to configure eCards settings and add cards.

1. From your eCards fundraiser, click **Manage Fundraiser**in the top right corner.

   ![image-20240820-201302.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20240820-201302.png)
2. Click **Purchase Options** on the left sidebar.

3. Click **eCards/Tribute cards**.

4. Scroll down and click **Purchase settings**to configure eCards settings and delivery methods on your fundraiser.

   ![image-20240820-201509.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20240820-201509.png)
   1. *Please note that if you leave '* ***Require card purchase to complete checkout*** *' un-checked, donors will be able to complete general donations without adding an eCard. Generally we recommend requiring card (eCard) purchases on eCard Store fundraisers.*

      ![image-20240820-201612.png](/__attachments/a_ea65b01638dfffbff3b93646c87cd05e9da23e2a9135b9f137113d659775bfab/image-20240820-201612.png?cb=26adafa76201cd3e6f8cedfe5c135400)
5. Click **Save**to confirm your choices.

6. Click**Create eCard** to add your first card.

   ![image-20240820-201803.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20240820-201803.png)
7. **Name** the card, set a **price** , enter **tags** for easy sorting and upload your **image**.

   ![image-20231123-154624.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20231123-154624.png)
8. Click **Save**to create the card.

   ![image-20231123-154707.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20231123-154707.png)
9. You may return to the eCards menu at any time to **add** , **edit, remove** or **preview**eCards.

## Adding the eCards block to your fundraiser

Next we recommend adding the eCards block to your fundraiser, which allows you to display select eCards on the main fundraiser page, providing a more seamless experience for potential purchasers.

1. Go to your fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser**in the top right.

   ![manage.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/manage.png)
2. Click **Design your fundraiser**.

   ![designnn.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/designnn.png)
3. Scroll down, hover over an existing block, and click the '**+**' icon.

4. Select **eCards block**.

   ![ecardsz.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/ecardsz.png)
5. The eCards block will appear, showing any eCards you have already added.

6. Click the **pencil**(edit) icon if desired to edit the cards shown, or adjust block colours and text.

   ![image-20231123-174630.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/image-20231123-174630.png)

## How to Edit the eCards Email Template

If you would like to change the default text of the eCard emails sent to recipients, follow these steps:

1. Go to your eCards fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser**in the top right.

2. Click**Automated email templates** on the left sidebar.

3. Click on **eCard Email** and toggle on '**I want to use my own text'.**

4. Edit the default text as desired and click **Save**.

   ![savezz.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/savezz.png)

## How to View the eCards Report

You can re-send, re-schedule, and/or cancel eCards from your **eCards Report**.

1. Go to your eCards fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser**in the top right.

2. Go to**Reports →** **eCards Report**.

3. From the **eCards Report**you can see all sent and pending cards, delivery status, and you have the ability to update scheduled delivery dates, cancel, resend or preview cards, change recipient emails, and more.

   ![reportz.png](../assets/how-to-create-an-ecards-store/reportz.png)

4. Click the **Download** button to download the Excel spreadsheet version of this report.

## A Note on Tax Receipting

Please note that **Tax Receipts** will only be issued for eCard purchases if the following are true:

* Tax Receipts have been enabled in the eCard store / fundraiser settings.

* The transaction amount meets the minimum amount set either at the site-wide, or fundraiser level.

# How to Use Tribute Cards

In this tutorial, you will learn how to set up and use **Tribute Cards**. The Tribute Cards feature allows you to create Memorial Fund / "In Memory Of" type fundraisers, or simply add tribute giving to your fundraiser.  
Tribute Cards can be sent via Email, postal Mail or SMS.  
![image-20231124-155840.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/image-20231124-155840.png)

## How to Enable Tribute Cards when Creating your Fundraiser

To use Tribute Cards on a fundraiser, you must enable the required feature while creating or editing it.

Here are the steps to enable Tribute Cards while creating a new fundraiser.

1. From the homepage of your CrowdChange site, click**Start a Fundraiser**in the top right corner.

   ![image-20231123-152708.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/image-20231123-152708.png)
2. Fill out all necessary information about your fundraiser on the **General Info** page.

   ![image-20231124-151234.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/image-20231124-151234.png)
3. Scroll down and click **Next** to continue to the **Additional Settings**page.

   ![nxt.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/nxt.png)
4. On the **Additional Settings** page, enable **eCards** under **Advanced Features** , and select **Tribute Cards** from the dropdown that appears.

   ![image-20231124-151322.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/image-20231124-151322.png)
5. Scroll down and click **Create Fundraiser**.

   ![image-20231123-153544.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/image-20231123-153544.png)

If creating an 'In Memory Of' / 'In Memoriam' style fundraiser, we recommend enabling personal fundraising pages as well so that donors can create their own pages in memory of their loved ones.

## How to Set Up Tribute Cards on your Fundraiser

Once the feature is enabled on your fundraiser, the next step is to configure your Tribute Cards purchase settings and add each of your Tribute Card options.

1. From your fundraiser, click **Manage Fundraiser**in the top right corner.

   ![managefundraiserbro.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/managefundraiserbro.png)
2. Go to **Purchase Options** on the left sidebar, then **Tribute Cards**.

3. Click**Purchase settings**to configure Tribute Cards settings and delivery methods on your fundraiser.

   ![image-20240820-202732.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/image-20240820-202732.png)
   1. *Please note that if you leave '* ***Require card purchase to complete checkout*** *' un-checked, donors will be able to complete general donations without adding a Tribute Card. Generally we recommend requiring card (Tribute Card) purchases on Tribute Giving fundraisers.*

      ![image-20240820-202757.png](/__attachments/a_8204e2875557fd63e102a9f0522840ef730235bc14e17dab21152a38b5ec5b2e/image-20240820-202757.png?cb=a4466d14a4e4cf49509aacee946bae6d)
4. Click **Save**to confirm your choices.

5. Click**Create Tribute Card**to add your first card.

   ![image-20240820-202832.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/image-20240820-202832.png)
6. **Name** the card, set a **Dedication type** (eg: In Memory of, In Honour of, In Celebration of, or custom), enter your **Dedication text** ,and upload an **Image**. For example:

   ![image-20231124-154223.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/image-20231124-154223.png)
7. Click **Save**in the bottom right to create the card.

8. You may return to the Tribute Cards menu at any time to **add** , **edit, remove** or **preview**cards.

Please note that **Tax Receipts** will only be issued for Tribute Card purchases if the following are true:

* Tax Receipts have been enabled in the Tribute Cards store / fundraiser settings.

* The transaction amount meets the minimum amount set either at the site-wide, or fundraiser level.

## How to Edit the Tribute Card Email Template

If you would like to change the default text of the Tribute Card email, follow these steps:

1. Go to your Tribute Cards fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser**in the top right.

2. Go to**Automated email templates** on the left sidebar.

3. Click on **Tribute Card Email** and toggle on '**I want to use my own text'.**

4. Edit the default text as desired and click **Save**.

   ![testimg.png](../assets/how-to-use-tribute-cards/testimg.png)

## Tribute Giving - Live Partner Examples

Here are a few examples of tribute giving fundraisers created by our partners:

* **Israel Cancer Research Fund - Tribute Cards:** <http://icrf.crowdchange.ca/1078>

  * Sending a card is tied to completing your donation.

* **Cystic Fibrosis Canada - In Memory:** <https://cysticfibrosistribute.crowdchange.ca/2196>

  * Uses Peer to Peer functionality, allowing supporters to create memorial pages on their own.

* **Kelowna General Hospital Foundation - Donate Today:** <http://kghfoundation.crowdchange.co/14594>

  * Gives donors the option for a **general** gift, an 'In honour of' / 'In memory of' gift **without** a card or an 'In honour of' / 'In memory of' gift **with**a card.

*** ** * ** ***

To create a **Donate Today** page like the Kelowna General Hospital Foundation example above:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site's homepage and click **Start a Fundraiser**.

2. Fill out the **General Info** page, then click **Next**.

3. On the **Additional Settings** page, under **Advanced Features** , toggle on **eCards** and select **Tribute Cards** from the dropdown that appears.

4. Click **Create Fundraiser**at the bottom of the page.

5. From the fundraiser's main page, click**Edit Mode** in the top right corner

6. Go to**Advanced settings → Setup → Tribute Cards**.

7. Click **Purchase Settings.**

8. Select **Require card purchase to complete checkout** if you'd like to make sending a card mandatory when completing a donation. Leaving this unchecked will give donors the option to add a card to their donation if they so desire - as in the KGH example: <http://kghfoundation.crowdchange.co/14594/donate>.

9. Select the delivery methods you would like to offer to your donors when sending a card (**Email** , **Mail** and/or **SMS**Text Message).

10. Click **Save** to confirm.

11. Next, click **New Tribute Card** to begin adding your Tribute Card options.

# How to Access Your Fundraiser's Donations Report

The **Donations Report** offers a quick and easy way to find information on all donations made to your fundraiser. You can also use it to [**resend receipts**](how-to-re-send-a-receipt-confirmation-email.md) and [**move donations**](how-to-move-donations-to-another-team-or-personal-.md) between personal or team pages.

To access it, follow the simple steps below:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and**Log In**.

2. Go to your fundraising page and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

   ![managefundraiserz.png](../assets/how-to-access-your-fundraiser-s-donations-report/managefundraiserz.png)
3. On the left sidebar, click **Reports** , then **Fundraiser Report**.

   ![image-20250723-155813.png](../assets/how-to-access-your-fundraiser-s-donations-report/image-20250723-155813.png)
4. You will be shown an **Overview**with the following information:

   ![image-20240821-134930.png](../assets/how-to-access-your-fundraiser-s-donations-report/image-20240821-134930.png)
5. Depending on which Purchase options you have enabled, you will also be shown 'Overview' sections with some basic details like sales of tickets, apparel, registration, etc, as well as information on teams and personal pages within your fundraiser. You can download any of these overview sections to Excel by clicking their respective **Download**button.

   ![image-20240821-135109.png](../assets/how-to-access-your-fundraiser-s-donations-report/image-20240821-135109.png)
6. If you need to see specific transactions and transaction details, scroll down to the **Detailed Report** section. Here you can search for specific transactions by Name, Email, and Transaction ID, and you can see the details of each transaction, including the amount, display name used, answers to custom questions, and more. You can see which team and/or personal page the donation was made to and change this via the **Change team or page**button.

   ![image-20240821-135229.png](../assets/how-to-access-your-fundraiser-s-donations-report/image-20240821-135229.png)
7. You can download the Excel version of this report via the **Download**button in the top right corner.

# How to Move Donations to another Team or Personal Page

As a fundraiser host or Admin user, moving donations from one Team or Personal Page to another, within a single fundraiser, is easily done via the fundraiser-level**Donations Report**.

To do this yourself, simply follow the steps below:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Go to your fundraiser (main fundraising page) and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

3. On the left sidebar, click**Reports** , then **Donations Report**.

4. Click on the transaction you would like to move to a different Team or Personal Page.

5. Click the **Change Team or page** button as highlighted below.

   ![changeteam.png](../assets/how-to-move-donations-to-another-team-or-personal-/changeteam.png)
6. Enter the Team and/or Personal Page you'd like to move this donation to and click **Save**.

   ![save3.png](../assets/how-to-move-donations-to-another-team-or-personal-/save3.png)

# How to Re-send a Receipt / Confirmation Email

As a fundraiser host or Admin user, you have the ability to re-send receipts. This is useful in cases where a donor/registrant/sponsor/purchaser did not receive their email confirmation. This is easily done via your fundraiser-level**Donations Report**.

To re-send a receipt / confirmation email, simply follow the steps below:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Go to the fundraiser the transaction was made to and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

3. Click **Reports** on the left sidebar and go to **Donations Report**.

   ![donationsreports.png](../assets/how-to-re-send-a-receipt-confirmation-email/donationsreports.png)
4. Scroll down to Detailed Report and search the **Transaction ID** ,**Name or Email Address**of the donor.

5. Click on the transaction and select **Resend Receipt**. See example below.

   ![resend.png](../assets/how-to-re-send-a-receipt-confirmation-email/resend.png)
6. Select **To** **original recipient** to re-send to the same email address, or **To** **specific Email** to send to an updated email address. If you select 'To specific Email', you will be prompted to enter the new email.

   ![image-20240821-140701.png](../assets/how-to-re-send-a-receipt-confirmation-email/image-20240821-140701.png)
7. Click **Send**to confirm.

# How to Access the Tickets Report (Fundraiser Level)

You can use your fundraiser's **Access Manager** to set administrative permissions for new or existing users. This is especially useful when you need to give **Edit** or **Reports Access** to a new user who does not have an existing CrowdChange account.

Once the desired permissions have been set, an invitation email will be sent to the new user, who will be prompted to create an account and accept the permissions.

To utilize this feature, click **Manage Fundraiser** , then**Access Manager** on the left sidebar.  
![managefundz.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-tickets-report-fundraiser-level/managefundz.png)  
![accessmanager.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-tickets-report-fundraiser-level/accessmanager.png)

On the Access Manager page, you can **give** , **edit** and **remove**custom access.

When users are given access, they will be listed and edit / remove controls will be shown.  
Please note that users you give access to using Access Manager will **not** receive **Fundraiser Notification Emails**. Currently, these are only sent to the Fundraiser Owner, and site-wide Admins.

## To Give Access

1. Click **Add Account**.

2. Enter the new or existing user's email and click **Continue**.

   1. If the user already exists in our system, you will see the name of the user.

   2. If the user does not yet exist, you will need to enter their first and last name.

3. Click the checkbox or toggle next to all permissions you desire the user to have, or click **Full Access**.

   ![image-20231028-145530.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-tickets-report-fundraiser-level/image-20231028-145530.png)
4. Click **Send Invite**in the bottom-right corner when ready.

### To Edit Access

1. Click the cog / gear icon next to the user you want to edit.

2. Click **Edit**.

   ![editaccess.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-tickets-report-fundraiser-level/editaccess.png)
3. Change permissions as desired and click **Save**.

### To Remove Access

1. Click the cog / gear icon next to the user you want to remove.

2. Click **Remove Access**.

   ![remove22.png](../assets/how-to-access-the-tickets-report-fundraiser-level/remove22.png)
3. Click **Yes**.

If your invitation is pending, you will instead see the option to **resend** , or **cancel**it.

# Fundraiser Approval (Non-Admin)

CrowdChange is strictly an online fundraising platform, and therefore we don't have authority to approve or reject fundraisers on your site.

It is only your **Charity /** **Organization** who has the authority to do so.

We recommend reaching out to them directly to ask about the approval status of your fundraiser.

# How Donation Matching Works

**Donation Matching**is a great way to encourage donors to increase the value of their donation, while also allowing corporate donors the chance to associate themselves with a large donation campaign.

Itallows your organization to designate an offline pool of funds which can be used as a multiplier for standard donations. This is a feature which must be enabled by a CrowdChange administrator, so please reach out to your Partner Success Representative if you wish to have it enabled.

To enable **Donation Matching** , toggle it on while creating your fundraiser under **Advanced Features**.  
![advancedfeatures.png](../assets/how-donation-matching-works/advancedfeatures.png)

Once your fundraiser is created, follow the steps below to set up Donation Matching.

1. Go to your fundraiser while logged in and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

2. Click **Donation Settings** on the left sidebar, then**Donation Matching**.

3. **Enable** the Donation Matching toggle slider and click **Save**.

4. Scroll down to set up Donation Matching, as described below.

You can select the **multiplier**you would like to use (2x, 3x, 4x, or 5x).

If desired, you can also set a **minimum** and **maximum**donation amount for matching. E.g. If a minimum of $25 is set, only donations $25 and above will be matched. If a limit of $500 is set, any donations made above that will only be matched up to $500.

The **Sponsors** section determines where you will draw your funds from. This is an offline pool of money, so please ensure that you are accounting for it with your sponsor directly. Click**Add Sponsor**to get started.

Set the **Sponsor Name** , and Pool**Amount** (this is essential so that you don't over-promise to your donors).  
![image-20240930-180530.png](../assets/how-donation-matching-works/image-20240930-180530.png)

Once these settings have been confirmed, all donations made during your Donation Matching campaign will show both the donated amount and the matched amount when looking at the **Donations**list:  
![example2.png](../assets/how-donation-matching-works/example2.png)

**Donor Receipts**will also show this matched amount, as well as the original donation amount.  
![summaryt.png](../assets/how-donation-matching-works/summaryt.png)

The **Donation Matching**menu will reflect any changes to the pool of funds, allowing you to keep up with how much money is available at any point in time for this matching campaign.  
![settings.png](../assets/how-donation-matching-works/settings.png)  
Details of matched amounts through a **Donation Matching** campaign can also be seen in the [**Admin Donations Report**](https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/How-to-Access-the-Admin-Donations-Report.2025226327.html).

================================================================================

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/how-pledging-works | Nav: How Pledging Works | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How Pledging Works

CrowdChange is equipped with **Pledging** functionality, allowing you to send a direct payment link to your donors via Email or SMS, so they can pay the pledge online. This link is fundraiser-specific and you can set the amount that your donor has committed to pay. This can be done using the **Offline Donations**page.

Please see the following steps to use this functionality:

1. Go to your CrowdChange fundraiser while logged in, and click **Manage Fundraiser**(Manage my page or Manage my team on P2P pages).

2. On the left sidebar, click **Offline Donations**.

3. Once on the **Offline Donations** page, click **Add Donation**.

4. Within **General Information**, enter your donor's first and last name, email address, and donation amount.

   1. If you would like to send the payment link via **Email** , click the checkbox under Email that says '**Send link for individual or group to make online payment**'. This will send your donor the payment link directly to their email address.

   2. If you would like to send the link via **SMS**, leave this box unchecked, and once the donation has been added, you will be able to click 'Share Payment Link' and send to a Phone Number.

      ![image-20231030-165621.png](/__attachments/a_d1a7c36a7796caeb842a9d72dbe77fe4515b4a2d3158be11ae16c6c55352c6a4/image-20231030-165621.png?cb=1092959d618cec517305c59000394cc3)
5. If a tax receipt is desired for this donation, within Tax Receipt Information, enable **Request tax receipt for this donation** and enter the donor's address \& postal code.

   ![image-20231030-165930.png](../assets/how-pledging-works/image-20231030-165930.png)
6. To assign the donation to a team or personal page, change the date of donation, payment method, display name, show/hide amount setting, comment and add notes, click **Show Advanced Settings** within **Additional Information**.

   ![image-20231030-170259.png](../assets/how-pledging-works/image-20231030-170259.png)
7. Click **Save** at the bottom to confirm. **DO NOT** check 'Mark as received'.

   ![image-20231030-170354.png](../assets/how-pledging-works/image-20231030-170354.png)

## How to Re-send a Pledge Payment Link

If you need to re-send a payment link to a Pledge you have already entered in Offline Donations, this can be done using the following steps:

1. Go to your CrowdChange fundraiser while logged in, and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

2. On the left sidebar, click **Offline Donations**.

3. Find the donation that you would like to send a payment link for and click on it to get to the **Edit Donation** menu.

4. At the bottom of the page, click on **Share Payment Link**. You will be able to send via Email or SMS.

   ![sharelink.png](../assets/how-pledging-works/sharelink.png)

If your fundraiser has **Tax Receipts** enabled, you can include your donor's Billing Address while entering their pledge. Tax Receipts can also be issued at a later date if you don't have this information, using the **Tax Receipts Report.**  
In a Pledging scenario, donors **do not** have the option to cover any transaction fees (Credit Card or CrowdChange platform fees) associated with the transaction.

# How to Contact the Host of a Fundraiser

CrowdChange is an online fundraising platform, and we're happy to help with any technical requests, however we are not the best people to ask about the details of an event!

In many cases, we recommend that you reach out to the host of the fundraiser directly.

To do so, please follow these steps:

1. On the fundraising page, scroll down to **Have questions?** and click **Contact Us**.

   ![image-20231117-150224.png](../assets/how-to-contact-the-host-of-a-fundraiser/image-20231117-150224.png)  
   ![image-20231117-150245.png](../assets/how-to-contact-the-host-of-a-fundraiser/image-20231117-150245.png)  
   ![contact.png](../assets/how-to-contact-the-host-of-a-fundraiser/contact.png)
2. In the popup that appears, select **I have a question for the host of this event**.

   ![send.png](../assets/how-to-contact-the-host-of-a-fundraiser/send.png)
3. Fill in your **Name** , **Email** , your **Message** , and click **Send**.

   ![send2.png](../assets/how-to-contact-the-host-of-a-fundraiser/send2.png)

**IMPORTANT:**

Ensurethat you select **I have a question for the host of this event**.

Selecting any other option will send your message to CrowdChange, not the event host.

# How to Edit Email Notifications

You have the ability to decide which email notifications you receive via your **My Notifications**page.

From there you can also set your preferred language for notifications, and unsubscribe from all if desired.

To access this page, follow these simple steps:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click **Profile** in in the top right corner, then**Notifications**.

   ![image-20250709-150255.png](../assets/how-to-edit-email-notifications/image-20250709-150255.png)

3. Turn off any undesired notifications by clicking the relevant toggle sliders. (Further explanation below)

   ![image-20250709-151106.png](../assets/how-to-edit-email-notifications/image-20250709-151106.png)

## Categories of Notifications

Notifications are sectioned off into the following categories (which of these you see will depend on your level of access and what type of pages you manage):

* **General**- Toggle on or off the 'Recurring donation receipt' - we recommend leaving this off, as you will receive a consolidated receipt at year-end for all your recurring donations.

![image-20250709-164254.png](../assets/how-to-edit-email-notifications/image-20250709-164254.png)

* **My fundraisers activity**- Set which notifications you receive for the fundraisers you manage, such as 'New Donation Received', 'Donation Refunded', 'Milestone Notifications' and more.

  ![image-20250709-163922.png](../assets/how-to-edit-email-notifications/image-20250709-163922.png)

* **My team activity**- Select which notifications you receive for your team page(s).

  ![myteamactivity.png](../assets/how-to-edit-email-notifications/myteamactivity.png)
* **My personal page activity** - Select which notifications you receive for your personal page(s).

  ![image-20250709-164507.png](../assets/how-to-edit-email-notifications/image-20250709-164507.png)

* **My banking notifications**- Select which (if any) banking-related notifications you receive.

  ![image-20250709-163853.png](../assets/how-to-edit-email-notifications/image-20250709-163853.png)

* **Admin Notifications**- As an Admin user on your CrowdChange site, here is where you will go to set or adjust your site-wide notifications settings. Note that if you have many fundraisers on your site, these notifications may result in many emails, so you may want to disable some from here, for example, 'New Donation Received'.

  ![image-20250709-151106.png](../assets/how-to-edit-email-notifications/image-20250709-151106.png)

For further information on CrowdChange Notifications and what exactly triggers them, check out [**this article**](https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/CrowdChange-Notifications.2149777409.html).

To unsubscribe from all notifications, click the toggle slider next to '**Turn off all notifications**' at the top.  
You can also get to**My Notifications** via the links at the bottom of our emails, as shown below:  
![Untitled.png](../assets/how-to-edit-email-notifications/Untitled.png)

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/data-included-in-donations-lists-and-amount-raised | Nav: Data included in Donations Lists and Amount Raised Bars | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Data included in Donations Lists and Amount Raised Bars

## Donations Lists

Donations Lists are shown on fundraisers where the '**Show list of donors** ' feature is enabled in fundraiser settings, and they can be either **Top Donations** or**Recent Donations**, depending on the option selected.

* **Top Donations** lists 10 donations sorted by highest amount. Blank ($0) amounts are sorted by name.

* **Recent Donations** lists 10 donations sorted by the most recent.

Clicking the '**See All** ' button within either list will show **ALL**donations, sorted by most recent.

* These lists always include the donor display name (entered in the '**Show my name as**' field at checkout), and the amount donated unless the donor chose to hide amount. Donors can choose the name they would like to be shown (My name, Anonymous, Family Friend, Supporter, or 'Enter your own name'), and can decide whether to show or hide their donation amount.

* Only Donations, Self-Donations, Sponsorships and Matched amounts are shown in Donations Lists.

* Tickets, apparel, and registrations are **not** included in the amounts shown for each donor.

* If the amount is hidden, or $0 (for example, a ticket purchase only) - only the name is shown with a blank donation amount.

## Amount Raised Bars

Raised amounts include both 'hidden' and 'anonymous' donations and are calculated as follows:

* **On Fundraisers**

  * \[Total Amount without covered or deducted fees\] + \[Matched Amounts\] - \[Refunds\]

  * Note: Total Amount **includes** tickets, apparel, registrations, and sponsorships

* **On Teams**

  * \[Donations to Team\] + \[Donations to Pages\] + \[Self-Donations to Pages\] + \[Matched Amounts\] + \[Sponsorships\] - \[Refunds\]

  * Note: Donations do **NOT** include tickets, apparel, or registrations.

* **On Personal Pages**

  * \[Donations to Page\] + \[Self-Donations to Page\] + \[Matched Amounts\] + \[Sponsorships\] - \[Refunds\]

  * Note: Donations do **NOT** include tickets, apparel, or registrations.

# CrowdChange Image Editor

The CrowdChange Image Editor allows you to make a wide variety of useful, beautiful edits to your fundraiser cover photo, and other Admin images such as Site Logo, Meta Image, and Tax Receipt images.

Check out all of the features below!

* Crop, Rotate, Zoom \& Flip images (*0:18*)

* Resize images with custom dimensions (*2:34*)

* Add filters to change the look of your images (*1:00*)

* Adjust Brightness, Contrast, Saturation, Exposure, Temperature, Gamma, Clarity \& Vignette (*1:21*)

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/image-size-guidelines | Nav: Image Size Guidelines | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Image Size Guidelines

When uploading images on CrowdChange, note that **.PNG** and **.JPG**are the preferred file types, and you can see our size guidelines for each image below:  

|        **Image**        | **Recommended Image Size** | **Aspect Ratio** |
|-------------------------|----------------------------|------------------|
| Fundraiser Cover Image  | 640 x 320 pixels           | 2:1              |
| eCards \& Tribute Cards | 1280 x 720 pixels          | 16:9             |

## New UI / Fundraiser Redesign - Hero Block Image Sizes

| **Hero Block Style** | **Recommended Image Size** | **Aspect Ratio** |
|----------------------|----------------------------|------------------|
| Full Screen          | 1920 x 699 pixels          | 640:233          |
| Centered             | 1228 x 420 pixels          | 307:105          |
| Side                 | 528 x 500 pixels           | 132:125          |

Including text information in Hero images goes against SEO and accessibility best practices.

This information should be within the text body of the page, so that search engines can find the pages and accessibility tools (e.g. screen readers) can operate correctly.

For further details on Hero images and responsive design best practices, please refer to the following article: <https://www.optimizely.com/optimization-glossary/hero-image/>

last_modified: '2024-09-02T19:18:51.427Z'

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/how-to-reset-your-password | Nav: How to Reset Your Password | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Reset Your Password

This process must be performed by the user themselves, using the steps below:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site.

2. Click **Login**on the top-right corner of the site.

   ![loginz.png](../assets/how-to-reset-your-password/loginz.png)
3. Within the popup that appears, enter your email and click **Next**.

   ![nextl.png](../assets/how-to-reset-your-password/nextl.png)
4. On the next page, click **Reset password**.

   ![resetit.png](../assets/how-to-reset-your-password/resetit.png)
5. On the next page, click **Next**.

   ![nextk.png](../assets/how-to-reset-your-password/nextk.png)
6. You will be sent an **email**with a link to a Password Reset page.

   ![image-20240902-191436.png](../assets/how-to-reset-your-password/image-20240902-191436.png)
7. Ensure you are still **logged out** of your CrowdChange site, then **click the link** in the email you received.

   ![resetttt.png](../assets/how-to-reset-your-password/resetttt.png)
8. Enter the new password that you would like to use and then click **Save**.

   ![image-20240902-191651.png](../assets/how-to-reset-your-password/image-20240902-191651.png)

Please note that password reset links expire in one hour. If you exceed that time, it will not work, and you will need to request a new link following the same steps above.  
If the user themselves is having trouble doing this, you can complete steps 1 through 5 on their behalf, and have them complete steps 6 and 7 once they have received the reset email.

They must be **logged out** before clicking the password reset link, or they will be directed to their Profile, where they would need to enter the current password as well as the new one.

# How to Opt Out of Email Marketing

CrowdChange does not share donor information for marketing purposes and will continue this practice moving forward. That said, we recommend reaching out to the organization you made your donation to directly to submit this request. Feel free to follow the steps below to do so:

1. Go to the fundraising page you are inquiring about.

2. Under the **"Have questions?"** section, click **"Contact Us"**.

3. Select "**I have a question for the host of this event**" from the drop-down menu.

4. Put in your question and it will be sent directly to the host who will be able to assist you.

## Unsubscribe from Mailing List emails

You can unsubscribe directly from Mailing List emails by clicking the unsubscribe button at the bottom of the email. See screenshot below:  
![unsubscribe.png](../assets/how-to-opt-out-of-email-marketing/unsubscribe.png)

# Refunds

CrowdChange cannot issue refunds for donations made on your CrowdChange site. This must be handled by an administrator from your **Charity / Organization**.

Please follow the steps below to send your request directly to an administrator:

1. Go to the fundraising page you are inquiring about.

2. Under the "**Questions?** " or "**Have Questions?** " section, click "**Contact Us**".

3. Select "**I have a question for the host of this event**" from the drop-down menu.

4. Put in your question and it will be sent directly to the host who will be able to assist you.

last_modified: '2021-09-07T16:53:41.475Z'
retrieved: '2026-10-14'
audience: Charities Non-Admin (CrowdChange help center space CNAK)
word_count: 251

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/failed-transaction | Nav: Failed Transaction | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Failed Transaction

Failed transactions can be the result of many factors including, but not limited to, the following:

* **Interrupted internet service**

  * Confirm your internet connection is stable and refresh the page, then retry your transaction.

* **Incorrect Billing Address**

  * Please make sure that your billing address is an exact match to the billing information associated with your Credit Card or else the payment will not be able to process.

* **Time-out**

  * Time-outs are common and usually caused by the following:

    * Page being left open for an extended period of time causing the token to expire.

    * Switching apps while filling out the form / billing info.

* **Internet browser being used**

  * Try a different web browser, or an incognito / private tab. We recommend Google Chrome. If you are still having trouble, turn off all plugins such as Adblock, refresh the page and try again.

* **Mistake in the payment information entered**

  * Double and triple-check that all payment information is correct.

Re-attempt your transaction. If you are still unable to process your transaction please contact us by clicking the blue **Help**button in the bottom right corner of this page.

## CSRF Token Mismatch

This is a common error message which can be caused by the following:

1. **Browser plugins** such as Adblock

2. Using **Incognito / Private browsing modes**

3. **Time-outs** (page being open for an extended period of time causing the token to expire) - Time-outs can also be caused on some devices by switching apps while filling out the form / billing info.

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/did-not-receive-a-confirmation-email-receipt | Nav: Did not receive a confirmation email / receipt | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Did not receive a confirmation email / receipt

You should receive an automatic email confirmation after making a donation and/or purchasing a ticket (with the PDF ticket attached).

If you have not, please try the following:

1. Check your email **spam folder** to ensure the email wasn't accidentally filtered out.

2. Log In to your **Profile** to ensure you entered the correct email address. See [How to Access Your Profile](how-to-access-your-profile.md)

3. In your Profile, go to the **My Receipts** tab for a log of all your transactions and tickets. If your transaction went through, it will be recorded here. You can **Download Tickets** and **Get Receipts** using the respective buttons next to each transaction.

If you think you may have made a **typo** in your email address, reach out to us via the blue **Help**button in the bottom right corner of this page, and we'll be happy to assist!

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/how-to-access-your-profile | Nav: How to Access Your Profile | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Access Your Profile

Your **Profile**is the place to go for changing your name, email address, and password. It also allows you to view your fundraisers, tickets, receipts and more.

Access it in 3 simple steps:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click **Profile** in in the top right corner, then**My Profile**.

   ![profil.png](../assets/how-to-access-your-profile/profil.png)
3. From your profile, you can change your name, title, email address, profile photo, and password.

4. Select a tab from the left sidebar to view other useful sections.

   ![profil2.png](../assets/how-to-access-your-profile/profil2.png)
5. Scroll down within your Profile to set up **Multi-Factor Authentication**. We recommend using the Authentication Application option.

   ![image-20231117-153040.png](../assets/how-to-access-your-profile/image-20231117-153040.png)

## Sections

Here's some information on what you can do in the other sections:

1. **My Fundraisers**- See all your fundraisers at a glance.

2. **My Settings** - Change your name, email address and password. You can also verify your email address here if you haven't already.

3. **My Receipts** - View and get all your receipts here as well as download any tickets purchased.

4. **My Recurring Donations** - You can make changes to or cancel your recurring donations here. To update your payment method, click the pencil icon next to the last 4 digits of your credit card number.

5. **My Tax Receipts**- You can download all your tax receipts from here.

If you need to set a custom meta description for your fundraiser(s), which will be used when sharing to social media platforms (instead of the fundraiser description), you can do so using the steps below.  
Please note that this feature is **NOT**enabled by default - you will need to reach out to your Partner Success Representative if you would like to use it.

Once the feature has been enabled on your site, you will be able to use it in 2 ways:

## Create / Edit Fundraiser Process

When creating or editing a fundraiser, look for the '**Meta Description**' field and enter your desired custom meta description for this fundraiser. It will be used in place of the fundraiser description when sharing to social media platforms.  
![metaz.png](../assets/set-a-custom-meta-description-for-fundraiser-socia/metaz.png)

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/setting-up-multi-factor-authentication-2fa | Nav: Setting Up Multi-Factor Authentication (2FA) | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Setting Up Multi-Factor Authentication (2FA)

**Multi-Factor Authentication**(commonly referred to as Two-Factor Authentication or 2FA) is the best way to secure your CrowdChange account against security breaches. This can be set up using the following steps:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and log in to your account.

2. In the upper right-hand corner of your CrowdChange site, click on **Profile → My Profile**.

3. Scroll down and toggle on **Multi-Factor Authentication**.

![multifactor.png](../assets/setting-up-multi-factor-authentication-2fa/multifactor.png)

There are three options for **Multi-Factor Authentication** - **Email, SMS,** and **Authentication Application**. These options refer to different methods by which a confirmation code will be provided to you in order for you to log in to your account.  
![methods.png](../assets/setting-up-multi-factor-authentication-2fa/methods.png)  
**Authentication Application** is by far the most secure option for **Multi-Factor Authentication** and is, therefore, our recommended choice (for all online applications, not just CrowdChange).

To use this method you will need to install an authentication app on your smartphone (there are some desktop applications as well). Unlike the SMS method, the authentication app method does not rely on receiving a code sent by the platform you want to log into.

When you first configure an authentication app to work with a platform, the app and platform exchange a secret code. This is generally done by using your device's camera to scan a QR code containing the shared secret. Using that secret code, the app then generates a numeric authentication code for you to enter into the platform when required. The authentication apps generate new codes every 30-60 seconds which must be entered before they expire.

**Here is a list of the most popular authentication apps:**

Google Authenticator ([Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/google-authenticator/id388497605), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.android.apps.authenticator2&hl=en_CA&gl=US))

Microsoft Authenticator ([Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/microsoft-authenticator/id983156458), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.azure.authenticator&hl=en_CA&gl=US))

Authy 2-Factor Authentication ([Desktop](https://authy.com/download/), [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/authy/id494168017), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.authy.authy))

1Password ([Desktop](https://1password.com/downloads/), [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/1password-password-manager/id568903335), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.agilebits.onepassword))

LastPass ([Desktop/Browser](https://lastpass.com/misc_download2.php), [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lastpass-for-premium-customers/id324613447?ign-mpt=uo%3D4), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lastpass.lpandroid))

# Recommended Web Browsers & Versions

CrowdChange is compatible with all modern web browsers. To ensure you get the best experience possible, we recommend using the most up-to-date version of one of the following:  

| **Browser** |         **Recommended Versions**          |
|-------------|-------------------------------------------|
| Chrome      | Latest                                    |
| Firefox     | Latest and extended support release (ESR) |
| Edge        | 2 most recent major versions              |
| Safari      | 2 most recent major versions              |
| iOS         | 2 most recent major versions              |
| Android     | 2 most recent major versions              |

Being a cloud platform, our software does not run natively on user devices. It is simply accessed via a web browser. Therefore we do not have specific Operating System requirements.

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/fundraiser-link-displays-page-not-found-error-mess | Nav: Fundraiser link displays 'Page not Found' Error message | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Fundraiser link displays 'Page not Found' Error message

If you have shared or visited a CrowdChange link and are seeing a '*Page not Found*' screen (otherwise known as "Error 404"), below are some possible reasons why:

* **Banking**information on the fundraiser has not been set up/verified by the payment processor (Stripe).

* The fundraiser is pending [**Approval**](fundraiser-approval-non-admin.md) from site admins.

* Incorrect URL: This is caused by mistyping or misspelling a URL.

* The page you are trying to view has been deleted and doesn't exist anymore.

# Participant Center

The Participant Center is your central fundraising hub, where you can view and manage all of your fundraisers, personal pages and/or team pages across your CrowdChange site. It gives you a high-level overview of your donor engagement, page strength, milestone achievements and more!  
Please note that this feature is **NOT** enabled by default.

If partners would like to opt in, they can request this via their Partner Success Representative.

To access the Participant Center (once enabled), from anywhere on your CrowdChange site, click the **Participant Center** button in the header at the top of the page, as shown below:  
![participant center.png](../assets/participant-center/participant_center.png)

Within your **Participant Center**, you have the following options (read below):  
![image-20240823-191105.png](../assets/participant-center/image-20240823-191105.png)

* Click **Edit Profile** in the top right corner to access your profile where you can upload a photo or edit your account details (name, email address, etc).

* Click either the **Fundraisers** , **Personal Pages** , or **Teams** tab to view the pages you own.

## Fundraisers Tab

From the **Fundraisers**tab, clicking a fundraiser tile (as shown below) will take you directly to it's public page where you can view or manage it as normal.  
![image-20240823-191243.png](../assets/participant-center/image-20240823-191243.png)

## Personal Pages Tab

On the **Personal Pages** tab, clicking a page tile (as shown below) will take you to that page's **Dashboard**, where you can get insight on the page strength, fundraising activity and milestone achievements.  
![image-20240823-190657.png](../assets/participant-center/image-20240823-190657.png)

### Personal Page Dashboard

Here is what your **Personal Page Dashboard** will look like:  
![image-20240823-190555.png](../assets/participant-center/image-20240823-190555.png)

You can get to the live Personal Page itself from here by clicking**View Page** in the top right corner.

The **Share**button in the top right corner is available for you to share your page via social media or link.  
![image-20250805-210655.png](../assets/participant-center/image-20250805-210655.png)

Within the left sidebar of your page dashboard, you can directly access specific menu options from your personal page, such as your **Page Settings** , **Mailing List** , **Report** , and **Offline Donations** menu.  
![image-20240823-191704.png](../assets/participant-center/image-20240823-191704.png)

Scrolling down within the page dashboard, you can view further metrics as well as your badge progress:  
![metrics1.png](../assets/participant-center/metrics1.png)

#### Activity Information \& Activity Badges

If the Activity Tracker is enabled, personal page dashboards within Participant Center will also show one more section: **Activity Tracker**. This section allows page owners to quickly view their activity progress, badges, and to access Activity Tracker from Participant Center to change or track activities.  
![image-20240823-193113.png](../assets/participant-center/image-20240823-193113.png)  
![image-20240823-193150.png](../assets/participant-center/image-20240823-193150.png)

This **Activity Tracker** sectionwill also be shown on the Personal Page itself.

## Teams Tab

On the **Teams** tab within Participant Center, clicking a team tile (as shown below) will take you to that team's **Dashboard**, where you can see further team details and donor metrics.  
![image-20240823-191816.png](../assets/participant-center/image-20240823-191816.png)

### Team Page Dashboard

Here is what your **Team Page Dashboard** will look like:  
![image-20240823-191926.png](../assets/participant-center/image-20240823-191926.png)

You can get to the Team Page itself from here by clicking**View Team**in the top right corner.

The **Share**button in the top right corner is available for you to share your team page via social media or link.

Within the left sidebar of your Team Page Dashboard, you can directly access specific menu options from your Team page, such as your **Page Settings** , **Mailing List** , **Report** , and **Offline Donations** menu.  
![image-20240823-192007.png](../assets/participant-center/image-20240823-192007.png)

#### Activity Highlights \& Activity Tracker Leaderboard

If the Activity Tracker is enabled, team page dashboards within Participant Center will also show two more sections: **Activity Highlights** and **Activity Tracker Leaderboard**. These sections provide Team Captains with useful information and statistics on the Activity engagement of their team members.  
![image-20240823-192209.png](../assets/participant-center/image-20240823-192209.png)

The **Activity Tracker Leaderboard**will also be shown on the Team Page itself.

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/activity-tracker | Nav: Activity Tracker | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Activity Tracker

The CrowdChange **Activity Tracker** feature allows you to create various Activities within your site, connected to fundraising campaigns, which participants can opt into and track progress towards, while achieving [Badges and Milestones](https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct/Badges-and-Milestones.2236383233.html). Scroll down to see an example use case of this functionality.

It's a great way to increase participant engagement with your campaign and your organization's mission.  
Please note that this feature is **NOT** enabled by default.

To have the Activity Tracker enabled, reach out to your Partner Success Representative today!  
![activitytracker2.png](../assets/activity-tracker/activitytracker2.png)

**When Activity Tracker is enabled on your site:**

* Fundraisers have a toggle slider within Advanced Features to enable Activity Tracker. Turning this on allows the fundraiser host to access Activities and enables the fundraiser-level Activity Tracker Report.

* Blueprints (if enabled) have a toggle slider to enable Activity Tracker. Turning this on allows fundraiser hosts using the blueprint to access Activities.

* Activity Tracker setup menu is added to Admin Dashboard under Fundraisers Settings → Activity Tracker.

The **Activity Tracker Admin Report** must also be enabled on your site by a CrowdChange Support Agent. Once enabled, it is added to the Admin Dashboard under Reports → Activity Tracker Report.

**Example Use-Case for Activity Tracker:**
> Nicholas has a personal fundraising page within the "*Jackie's Joyathon* " fundraiser, hosted by "*Run for Joy Canada*". The organization has set up activity challenges leading up to the day of the event such as "Jog for 10 minutes every day" and "Eat 7 fruits/vegetables each week", etc.

Using Activity Tracker on his page, Nicholas can track and publicly show his progress towards these activities.

He can also do so via his Personal Page Dashboard within Participant Center (if enabled).

His activity progress is shown publicly (if desired) within the Activity Tracker block on his personal page.

## Getting Started with Activity Tracker

**Please Note:** You will not be able to follow these instructions until Activity Tracker has been enabled on your site by a CrowdChange Partner Success Representative or Support Agent.

### **Enabling Activity Tracker on a New FundraiserEnabling Activity Tracker on a New Fundraiser**

Activity Tracker must be enabled on a fundraiser by fundraiser basis. Additionally, to use it fully, P2P fundraising pages must be toggled on. Follow the simple steps below to enable it on a new fundraiser:

1. From the home page of your CrowdChange site, click the **Start a Fundraiser**button.

   ![startfundraiser3.png](../assets/activity-tracker/startfundraiser3.png)
2. On the **General Info** page, fill out all required information and click **Next**.

3. On the **Additional Settings** page, enable some or all of the following under**Peer-to-peer features**:

   1. *Personal fundraising pages*

   2. *Team fundraising pages*

   3. *Personal fundraising pages within teams*

4. Under **Advanced Features** , turn **ON** the **Activity tracker** toggle slider.

   ![activitytracker4.png](../assets/activity-tracker/activitytracker4.png)
5. Click **Create Fundraiser**at the bottom of the page.

### **Enabling Activity Tracker on an Existing Fundraiser**

Activity Tracker must be enabled on a fundraiser by fundraiser basis. Additionally, to use it fully, P2P fundraising pages must be toggled on. Follow the simple steps below to enable it on an existing fundraiser:

1. While logged in, go to your fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

   ![managem.png](../assets/activity-tracker/managem.png)
2. Click **Peer to Peer features**on the left sidebar.

3. Enable some or all of the following under**Peer-to-peer features**:

   1. *Personal fundraising pages*

   2. *Team fundraising pages*

   3. *Personal fundraising pages under a team can be created (within Personal fundraising pages)*

4. Scroll down and click **Save**.

5. On the left sidebar, click **Activity Tracker**.

6. Enablethe **Activity tracker** toggle slider.

   ![image-20240821-191235.png](../assets/activity-tracker/image-20240821-191235.png)
7. Click **Save**to confirm.

### **Setting up an Activity at the Fundraiser Level**

Activities can also be set up at the individual fundraiser level (once Activity Tracker has been enabled on both the site and the specific fundraiser) by following these steps:

1. While logged in, go to your fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

   ![managem.png](../assets/activity-tracker/managem.png)
2. Click **Activity Tracker**on the left sidebar.

3. Scroll down and click the **Create Activity**button.

   ![image-20240821-191358.png](../assets/activity-tracker/image-20240821-191358.png)
4. Select the **Activity Basis** (what unit will be measured) in the popup that appears and click **Next**.

   ![activity basis.png](../assets/activity-tracker/activity_basis.png)
5. Fill out all the details of your activity, such as **name** , **description** , and **start/end dates**.

6. Set Types (if applicable) and an image for the activity and click **Save**.

#### **Setting up Badges \& Milestones for the Activity**

After creating an activity, you will be prompted to add **Badges**for the activity:

1. Click on **Add Badge**and fill out all the required information.

   ![addbadge.png](../assets/activity-tracker/addbadge.png)
2. Before saving, create a **Milestone email**under 'Message content' to be sent to the participant on achievement of this Badge.

3. Click **Save** , and you'll be taken to the Badges menu, where you can return at any time to **Add** or **Edit** badges.

4. Click**Back to Activities**in the top left corner to return to the Activity Tracker menu.

5. You can return here at any time to **Add** , **Edit** or **Archive**activities.
