# Opting in to an Activity and Tracking Progress

As a participant to a fundraising campaign with your own personal fundraising page, you have the ability to opt into any Activities created at the Admin or Fundraiser level via your Participant Center.  
On fundraisers using our multi-registration workflow, registrants can also opt-in during this process.

Follow the simple steps below to select and track an activity:

1. Go to your **Participant Center** (click the button at the top of your page).

   ![participantbtn.png](../assets/opting-in-to-an-activity-and-tracking-progress/participantbtn.png)
2. Click the **Personal Pages** tab under your name.

   ![img22.png](../assets/opting-in-to-an-activity-and-tracking-progress/img22.png)
3. Click on your specific personal page tile.

   ![tile.png](../assets/opting-in-to-an-activity-and-tracking-progress/tile.png)
4. Scroll down to the **Activity Tracker** section.

5. Click **See all available activities** , or the **Start tracking** buttonon an activity shown.

   ![test222.png](../assets/opting-in-to-an-activity-and-tracking-progress/test222.png)
   1. If you clicked **See all available activities** , click the**Start Tracking**button on the specific activity you would like to track progress towards. You may only track one activity at a time.

      ![select.png](/__attachments/a_20aa5bdd6fda9fd61448e852a0300e4086930f0ffde792c5b5f0b994a2b41666/select.png?cb=76038618c94fe70bdc5c453b0b641228)
6. On the activity page, you can click the **Start Tracking** button, then the **Track Activity**button to track your first repetition of the activity:

   ![starttt.png](../assets/opting-in-to-an-activity-and-tracking-progress/starttt.png)
   Start tracking  
   ![track.png](../assets/opting-in-to-an-activity-and-tracking-progress/track.png)
   Track activity
7. Track activities consistently without missing a day to earn a streak, which will count towards **Badges and Milestones** ! Badges and Milestones can also be linked to a **total**reached instead of a streak if desired.

   ![streaks.png](../assets/opting-in-to-an-activity-and-tracking-progress/streaks.png)

Some activities are**total-based** rather than**streak-based**, meaning that even if you miss a day, all days tracked within the activity time period will still count towards Badges and Milestones.

Any time you reach a **Milestone** set at the Activity level, you will receive a Milestone Notification Email and any associated **Badge**, which will live within your Participant Center and if desired, publicly on your page.  
![badges2.png](../assets/opting-in-to-an-activity-and-tracking-progress/badges2.png)

## How to Hide Activity Progress

If you do not want your Activity progress to be displayed publicly on your personal fundraising page, follow the steps below to disable this feature:

1. Go to your **Participant Center** (click the button at the top of your page).

2. Click the **Personal Pages** tab.

3. Click on your personal page tile.

4. Scroll down to the **Activity Tracker** section.

5. Click **Manage Activity**on the activity you are tracking.

6. Scroll down to the bottom of the page and disable the '**Show Activity tracker on my page**' toggle.

![privacy.png](../assets/opting-in-to-an-activity-and-tracking-progress/privacy.png)

# Connecting with Strava

If you already use Strava to track your fitness activity, you can quickly connect your Strava account to CrowdChange so that tracked activity going forward is also tracked in CrowdChange.  
Please note that our Strava integration only works with distance based Activities (km or miles).

Once enabled, all supported data from your Strava activities (**going forward**) is automatically transferred to your selected activity within the CrowdChange Activity Tracker.

Here's how you can set this up!

## How to Connect to Strava

1. Go to your **Participant Center** (click the icon at the top of your screen).

   ![participantbtn.png](../assets/connecting-with-strava/participantbtn.png)
2. Click the **Personal Pages** tab under your name.

   ![img22.png](../assets/connecting-with-strava/img22.png)
3. Click on your specific personal page tile.

   ![tile.png](../assets/connecting-with-strava/tile.png)
4. Scroll down to the **Activity Tracker** section (Your Current Activity will be shown).

   ![image-20250118-205050.png](../assets/connecting-with-strava/image-20250118-205050.png)
5. Click **Manage Activity** (pictured bottom right above).

6. You will be taken to the Activity Tracker Dashboard of your personal page.

   ![image-20250118-205207.png](../assets/connecting-with-strava/image-20250118-205207.png)
7. Click **Connect with Strava** (pictured above).

8. You will be redirected to Strava's website where you must log in to your Strava account.

   ![image-20250118-205317.png](../assets/connecting-with-strava/image-20250118-205317.png)
9. You will then be prompted to authorizethe required permissions for the integration to function.

   ![image-20250117-214013.png](../assets/connecting-with-strava/image-20250117-214013.png)
10. Click **Authorize**and you will be redirected to CrowdChange where you will see Strava is now connected.

    ![connected2.png](/__attachments/a_5376e630aade2a674b32acbd64756bc95b5e25b7953b338800fa7dbe471ac0a1/connected2.png?cb=fb6f7dbcfa29b82bf499efda9c78a800)

Distance based entries you make in Strava will now be automatically reflected within your CrowdChange Activity Tracker.

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/editing-or-deleting-activity-records | Nav: Activity Tracker > Editing or Deleting Activity Records | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Editing or Deleting Activity Records

Participants have the ability to **Edit** or **Delete**any records previously entered in the Activity Tracker.

This functionality is available for all metric types (Days, Hours and Distance).

Follow the simple steps below in order to to edit or delete a record.

## To Edit a Record

1. Go to your **Personal Page** and scroll down to the**Activity Tracker** section.

2. Click **Manage Activity**.

3. Under **My Records** click **See more records**.

4. Click the **triple-dot icon** next to the record you want to edit and click **Edit**.

5. Make the necessary changes and click **Save**.

## To Delete a Record

1. Go to your **Personal Page** and scroll down to the**Activity Tracker** section.

2. Click **Manage Activity**.

3. Under **My Records** click **See more records**.

4. Click the **triple-dot icon** next to the record you want to delete and click **Delete**.

5. Click **Yes**.

# Activity Tracker Reporting

## **Fundraiser Level Activity Tracker Report**

To view the Fundraiser Level Activity Tracker Report, follow the steps below:

1. From anywhere on your CrowdChange site, **Log In**.

2. Go to your fundraising page and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

3. Go to**Reports** on the left sidebar, then**Activity Tracker Report**.

4. From here, you can **Search** and/or **Filter** for specific Activities, and view a simple overview.

   ![report2.png](../assets/activity-tracker-reporting/report2.png)
5. You may also export this report to Excel using the **Download**button.

Note that the fundraiser-level version of this report is less detailed than the Admin version.

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/how-to-close-archive-or-delete-a-p2p-page | Nav: Featured > How to Close, Archive, or Delete a P2P Page | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Close, Archive, or Delete a P2P Page

We offer a few different options for deactivating your personal or team fundraising page:

* **Close Page** - This will stop transactions being made through the page. The page will still be publicly accessible and visible in lists. As page owner or admin, you can still make changes to the page.

* **Archive Page** - This will make the page invisible to the public and stop transactions through it. It will only be accessible to admins.

* **Delete Page** - This option only becomes available after a page is archived. Non-archived pages cannot be deleted.

## Closing a Personal or Team Page

To close your personal or team page and prevent further transactions through it, follow these steps:

1. Go to your personal or team page and **Login**.

   ![login.png](../assets/how-to-close-archive-or-delete-a-p2p-page/login.png)
2. Click **Manage my Page** (or **Manage my Team**) in the top right corner.

   ![image-20240821-203815.png](../assets/how-to-close-archive-or-delete-a-p2p-page/image-20240821-203815.png)
3. Click **Page Settings**on the left sidebar.

4. Scroll down to **Administrative Settings** and click **Settings** , then **Close My Page (or Team)**.

   ![settings.png](../assets/how-to-close-archive-or-delete-a-p2p-page/settings.png)
5. Click **Close**on the popup that appears to confirm.

   ![image-20240705-140739.png](../assets/how-to-close-archive-or-delete-a-p2p-page/image-20240705-140739.png)

## Archiving a Personal or Team Page

To archive your personal or team fundraising page so it is no longer publicly visible and cannot process transactions, follow the steps below:

1. Go to your personal or team page and **Login**.

   ![login.png](../assets/how-to-close-archive-or-delete-a-p2p-page/login.png)
2. Click **Manage my Page** (or **Manage my Team**) in the top right corner.

   ![image-20240821-203815.png](../assets/how-to-close-archive-or-delete-a-p2p-page/image-20240821-203815.png)
3. Click **Page Settings**on the left sidebar.

4. Scroll down to **Administrative Settings** and click **Settings** , then **Archive My Page (or Team)**.

   ![archive2.png](../assets/how-to-close-archive-or-delete-a-p2p-page/archive2.png)
5. Click **Archive**on the popup that appears to confirm.

   ![image-20240705-141249.png](../assets/how-to-close-archive-or-delete-a-p2p-page/image-20240705-141249.png)

BONUS - Unarchiving a Personal or Team Page  

## Unarchiving a Personal or Team Page

To unarchive your personal fundraising page and reverse the archive action, follow the steps below:

1. Go to your personal or team page and **Login**.

   ![login.png](../assets/how-to-close-archive-or-delete-a-p2p-page/login.png)
2. Click **Manage my Page** (or **Manage my Team**) in the top right corner.

   ![image-20240821-203815.png](../assets/how-to-close-archive-or-delete-a-p2p-page/image-20240821-203815.png)
3. Click **Page Settings**on the left sidebar.

4. Scroll down to **Administrative Settings** and click **Settings** , then **Unarchive My Page (or Team)**.

   ![unarchive.png](../assets/how-to-close-archive-or-delete-a-p2p-page/unarchive.png)
5. Click **Unarchive**on the popup that appears to confirm.

   ![image-20240705-141432.png](../assets/how-to-close-archive-or-delete-a-p2p-page/image-20240705-141432.png)

## Deleting a Personal or Team Page

To delete your personal or team page, archive it first using the steps above, then do the following:

1. Go to your personal or team page and **Login**.

   ![login.png](../assets/how-to-close-archive-or-delete-a-p2p-page/login.png)
2. Click **Manage my Page** (or **Manage my Team**) in the top right corner.

   ![image-20240821-203815.png](../assets/how-to-close-archive-or-delete-a-p2p-page/image-20240821-203815.png)
3. Click **Page Settings**on the left sidebar.

4. Scroll down to **Administrative Settings** and click **Settings** , then **Delete My Page (or Team)**.

   ![delete2.png](../assets/how-to-close-archive-or-delete-a-p2p-page/delete2.png)
5. Enter a reason for the deletion in the popup that appears and click **Delete** to confirm.

   ![image-20240705-141732.png](../assets/how-to-close-archive-or-delete-a-p2p-page/image-20240705-141732.png)

# How to Adjust Default Donation Amounts & Settings

After creating your fundraiser on CrowdChange, the next step is to confirm your desired default donation amounts and settings. We also highly recommend adding **Impact Statements** and **Images** to each default donation amount. To make these changes, you will need to access your fundraiser's **Donation Settings**.  
**Please Note:** Impact Statements and Images are NOT enabled by default.

Reach out to your Partner Success Representative today to request they be enabled!

Follow the simple steps below to access this menu:

1. Go to your CrowdChange site and**Log In**.

2. Navigate to the fundraiser you have created.

3. Click **Manage Fundraiser** in the top right corner of the page.

4. Click **Donation Settings**on the left sidebar.

5. From the **Donation Settings** section, you can enable or disable donations, the donation list, tax receipts, and set service fee behavior at checkout.

   ![image-20240816-203513.png](../assets/how-to-adjust-default-donation-amounts-settings/image-20240816-203513.png)  
   ![image-20240816-203533.png](../assets/how-to-adjust-default-donation-amounts-settings/image-20240816-203533.png)
6. Click into **Donation Amounts \& Types** to set your accepted and default donation types (eg. monthly, annual, one-time), set a minimum recurring donation amount, and adjust default donation amounts for One-Time, Monthly, and Annual donations (if enabled) separately. You can also add **Impact Statements** and images if this feature is enabled. For example:

   ![image-20230929-144321.png](../assets/how-to-adjust-default-donation-amounts-settings/image-20230929-144321.png)  
   ![image-20230929-151022.png](../assets/how-to-adjust-default-donation-amounts-settings/image-20230929-151022.png)  
   ![image-20230929-151144.png](../assets/how-to-adjust-default-donation-amounts-settings/image-20230929-151144.png)  
   ![image-20230929-144416.png](../assets/how-to-adjust-default-donation-amounts-settings/image-20230929-144416.png)

**Remember** that you can set up donation amounts, impact statements and images **separately**for your One-Time, Monthly and Annual donation options.

To customize Monthly donations, click '**Set Monthly Donation Amounts**' shown above.

To customize Annual donations, click '**Set Annual Donation Amounts**' shown above.

If Monthly and Annual donations are not customized, they will use the One-Time donations settings.

6. Ensure to click **Save** at the bottom to confirm your settings.

   You can also undo all changes made by clicking **Reset changes**.

================================================================================

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/how-to-start-a-fundraiser-on-crowdchange | Nav: Featured > How To Start a Fundraiser on CrowdChange | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How To Start a Fundraiser on CrowdChange

You can create a custom fundraising page on your CrowdChange site in under 5 minutes!

Simply follow the steps below:

1. Click the **Start A Fundraiser** button in the top-right corner of your CrowdChange site.

   ![startfunds.png](../assets/how-to-start-a-fundraiser-on-crowdchange/startfunds.png)
2. Fill out the **General Information** page, toggling on any features you'd like to use for your fundraiser under **Purchase options**. For example:

   ![image-20240823-143705.png](../assets/how-to-start-a-fundraiser-on-crowdchange/image-20240823-143705.png)  
   ![image-20240823-143736.png](../assets/how-to-start-a-fundraiser-on-crowdchange/image-20240823-143736.png)
3. Click **Next** and further customize your fundraiser on the **Additional Settings**page, enabling P2P features and more as/if needed.

   ![image-20240823-143918.png](../assets/how-to-start-a-fundraiser-on-crowdchange/image-20240823-143918.png)
4. Click **Create Fundraiser** at the bottom to sign up / log in and publish your fundraiser.

5. Use the **Share**button to get the word out to your friends \& family!

Please see the following related tutorials as well:

* [How Ticketing Works](how-ticketing-works.md)
* [How Merchandise Works](how-merchandise-works.md)
* [How Registration Works](how-registration-works.md)
* [How Sponsorship Works (Sponsorship Packages)](how-sponsorship-works-sponsorship-packages.md)
* [How to Create a Personal Fundraising Page \& Share It](how-to-create-a-personal-fundraising-page-share-it.md)
* [How to Create a Team \& Invite Members](how-to-create-a-team-invite-members.md)
## Detailed Steps:

1. Click the **Start A Fundraiser** button in the top-right corner of your CrowdChange site.

2. Fill out the **General Information** page:

   1. Fundraiser is bilingual - This allows you to enter all information in both English and French.

   2. Fundraiser Name - Set a name for your fundraiser that will be the main heading.

   3. In support of - You may be allowed to choose from a list of options, or type your own.

   4. Goal - You can turn the goal feature on or off, and set it to either a certain amount raised, or a certain number of donors.

   5. Date and time - Turn this on if you want to show a start date / time for your fundraiser.

   6. Fundraiser has an end date and time - Turn this on if you want to show an end date / time for your fundraiser.

   7. Fundraiser has a location - Turn this on if you want to show the location of your fundraiser.

   8. Fundraiser Description - Enter all the information donors \& participants will need to know.

   9. Cover Image - Upload a banner / header image for your fundraiser.

   10. Add a Video - Allows you to paste a video link so that a video will be displayed instead of the Cover Photo on your fundraising page.

3. Under **Purchase options**enable any features you want to use for your fundraiser:

   1. My event has tickets - See **How Ticketing Works**

   2. My event has apparel / merchandise - See **How Merchandise Works**

   3. My event has registration - See **How Registration Works**

   4. My event offers sponsorship packages - See **How Sponsorships Work**

   5. My fundraiser has custom questions - See **How to Use Custom Questions**

4. Click **Next** and enable **Peer-to-peer features**:

   1. Personal fundraising pages - See **How to Create Personal Page**

   2. Team fundraising pages - See **How to Create a Team**

   3. Personal fundraising pages within teams - Allow personal pages to be created under teams.

   4. Set default content for personal pages - Set a default description for personal pages.

   5. Set default content for team pages - Set a default description for team pages.

5. Enable and set up **Registration Features** if desired and if Multi-Registration is enabled on your site.

6. **Advanced Features**:

   1. Donations are tax deductible - Enable only if you will be issuing tax receipts for this fundraiser.

   2. eCards - Turn on and select **Tribute Cards** if you would like to set up personal pages 'In honor of' or 'In memory of' individuals. Otherwise, select **eCards**.

   3. Collect Mailing Information - Turn on if you want to collect donor mailing information specifically.

   4. Allows donors without emails to use their physical address - Let donors donate \& register without an email address.

   5. Hidden event - Hide fundraiser from the public so only Admins and those with a link can find it.

   6. Show list of donors - Turn on if you want a public donor list for your fundraiser.

   7. Start accepting funds on date - Turn on if you want the fundraiser to open automatically at a certain date / time. A countdown will be displayed.

   8. Stop accepting funds on date - Be sure to turn this on to set a close-off date for your fundraiser.

   9. Donation matching - Enable if you would like donations to be matched. You will be able to set up the matching pool and settings through **Donation Matching** once enabled.

7. Click the **Create Fundraiser** button to sign up or log in - if you haven't already, otherwise, you are ready to start sharing your fundraiser!

You can hide the 'Share' button on your fundraiser if desired using the steps below:

1. From your fundraiser, click **Manage Fundraiser** in the top-right corner.

2. Click **Design your fundraiser**.

3. Hover over your banner/hero image and click the **Gear**icon on the left.

4. On the right sidebar, within the **Layout** section, click **Set up sharing**.

5. Disable **Show on page** and click **Save**at the bottom.

================================================================================

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/per-transaction-limits-for-purchase-options | Nav: Per-transaction Limits for Purchase Options | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Per-transaction Limits for Purchase Options

You can now set limits on the number of items a supporter can purchase in a single transaction - perfect for enforcing rules like "2 tickets per person" or "limit 1 hoodie per order."

This feature can be used for:

* **Tickets**

* **Registration**

* **Apparel \& merchandise**

## How it works

When a quantity limit is set, users will not be able to add more than that number of the selected item to their cart. This is especially useful for capacity control or limiting availability of high-demand items.

### How to Set a Limit

1. Go to your fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser** in the top-right.

2. From the left sidebar, click **Purchase Options**.

3. Choose one of the following categories:

   * **Tickets**

   * **Registration**

   * **Apparel \& Merchandise**

4. Click on the item you wish to edit (or create a new one).

5. Find the field labeled **Limit per transaction** and enter the desired number.

   *(Leave this blank for unlimited.)*

6. Click **Save**.

📸 *See screenshot example below from the Tickets section:*  
![image-20250902-180920.png](../assets/per-transaction-limits-for-purchase-options/image-20250902-180920.png)
**Limit per transaction** settings within the **Tickets** section of the **Fundraiser dashboard**

*** ** * ** ***

**Limits can be set individually per item** - for example, you could allow 5 tickets per transaction, but only 1 hoodie.  
![image-20250902-182053.png](../assets/per-transaction-limits-for-purchase-options/image-20250902-182053.png)
**Limit per transaction** settings within an individual **Ticket** type

If an item has **variations** (like sizes), the limit applies **across all variations**. For example, a limit of 2 would allow the user to purchase 1 Small + 1 Medium, but not 3 of any combination.

*** ** * ** ***

Limits can also be applied per transaction to individual **variations** of a specific purchase option item - meaning you could limit popular sizes of a merchandise item if stock is low.  
![image-20250903-144638.png](../assets/per-transaction-limits-for-purchase-options/image-20250903-144638.png)
**Limit per transaction** settings shown at the Purchase Option Item **Variation**level

# Access Codes for Purchase Options (Pre-Sale or Private Tickets, Merchandise, Registration, and Sponsorship)

**Access Codes** is a feature that allows you to gate access to purchase options (tickets, apparel and merchandise, registration, or sponsorships) behind a password. This can allow you to have separate, specialized purchase tiers that are only accessible to those who have been given a specific code. This can be used for:

* Pre-Sale Codes

* Special Discounted Purchase Tiers

* Staff or Friends and Family Purchase Tiers

The **Access Codes**feature is currently in beta, and therefore is not available on CrowdChange by default. If your organization does not have access to this feature, and feel like it would be a worthwhile addition to your site, speak to your Partner Success Manager to discuss adding this function.

*** ** * ** ***

**Access Codes** are turned on via the **Purchase Options** menu within the **Fundraiser Dashboard** . To enable this option for any purchase options, simply toggle it on under *Additional Features*.

To do this, please follow these steps:

* Go to your fundraiser (please ensure you are logged in)

* Click **Manage my fundraiser** to access the **Fundraiser Dashboard**

* From the Fundraiser Dashboard, click **Purchase options**

* In the *Additional features* section, toggle on **Access codes**

* Below the Access codes toggle, click Save to save your settings

![image-20250508-142339.png](../assets/access-codes-for-purchase-options-pre-sale-or-priv/image-20250508-142339.png)
\<p\>Toggle on \<strong\>Access codes\</strong\> in the \<em\>Additional features\</em\> section of the \<strong\>Purchase options \</strong\>menu\</p\>

Once this function is toggled on, you can **Assign access codes**to any existing Purchase Option tiers:  
![image-20250508-142753.png](../assets/access-codes-for-purchase-options-pre-sale-or-priv/image-20250508-142753.png)
\<p\>Click \<strong\>Assign access codes\</strong\> to set up a new code\</p\>

Once you click **Assign access codes** , you will be prompted to either enter or generate a new code. If you select **Generate**, a random code will be created. Once you have established your code, you can choose whether to assign this code to all purchase tiers, or select the tiers that this code will apply to.  
![image-20250508-143305.png](../assets/access-codes-for-purchase-options-pre-sale-or-priv/image-20250508-143305.png)
\<p\>Apply your Access Code to the desired tiers that you would like to gate behind a password\</p\>

Once you have selected your purchase tiers, click **Apply** to save your changes.

*** ** * ** ***

You can also assign an **Access code** to a purchase option within the individual purchase option tier setup page - this is also accessible when creating a new tier.  
![image-20250508-143531.png](../assets/access-codes-for-purchase-options-pre-sale-or-priv/image-20250508-143531.png)
\<p\>The \<strong\>Access codes \</strong\>function is available on a tier-by-tier basis for all Purchase Options\</p\>

*** ** * ** ***

Once your code is in place, if a user attempts to select the Purchase Option in question, they will see a field to input a password to access the desired Purchase Option.  
![image-20250508-143817.png](../assets/access-codes-for-purchase-options-pre-sale-or-priv/image-20250508-143817.png)

If there are both public tiers and limited access tiers, users can select where to browse using the options in the menu header . If all purchase tiers require an access code, users will only see the Limited Access menu, shown above. Once the user inputs the correct code, the limited access tiers will be made available to them.  
![image-20250508-144010.png](../assets/access-codes-for-purchase-options-pre-sale-or-priv/image-20250508-144010.png)

# How to Mass Upload Offline Donations Using a CSV File

You can now upload multiple offline donations at once using our CSV upload tool. This feature is helpful when you have collected several cash or cheque donations offline and want to add them quickly to your fundraiser in CrowdChange.

*** ** * ** ***

## How to Access the CSV Upload Tool

1. Go to your fundraiser on your CrowdChange site and **Log In**.

2. Click **Manage fundraiser** in the top-right corner.

3. In the fundraiser dashboard menu, select **Offline donations**.

4. Click the **Upload .csv file** button.

A modal will appear where you can download the CSV template and upload your completed file.  
![image-20251125-165945.png](../assets/how-to-mass-upload-offline-donations-using-a-csv-f/image-20251125-165945.png)
A view of the .csv upload tool feature, with the **Upload .csv file** button highlighted

*** ** * ** ***

## Step 1: Download the CSV Template

Before uploading, download the required template and fill it in. You can download the template by clicking **Download template.csv** in the above-pictured modal.

Do not rename or change any column headers, as this may prevent your file from being processed.  
**Important:**All rows in the CSV will be treated as new donations. Duplicate entries will not be merged. Once the upload begins, it cannot be paused or cancelled.

*** ** * ** ***

## Step 2: Upload Your File

1. Open the **Upload .csv file** modal.

2. Drag and drop your completed CSV into the upload area, or click **Upload file** to select it.

3. Review the summary on screen.

4. Click **Import** to complete the upload.

*** ** * ** ***

## What Happens After Upload

### Donation Status

All uploaded offline donations will be created with the status **Pending** by default.

Pending offline donations:

* Do appear in the Admin-level donations report, but their status will be indicated as **Pending**.

* Do appear as pending contributions on the fundraiser dashboard for admins and hosts.

To confirm an offline donation:

* Open the donation entry from **Offline donations**.

* Change the status to **Received**.

### Tax Receipts

Tax receipts are **not** automatically issued for offline donations uploaded via CSV.

If your organization issues tax receipts:

* Receipts must be issued **manually** , after upload, **one donation at a time**.

* Tax receipts can only be issued on offline donations that are marked as **Received**.

* This can be done from the donation's details page or through the Tax Receipts Report, depending on your site's configuration.

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/how-to-upload-a-list-of-teams-or-personal-pages-us | Nav: How to Upload a List of Teams or Personal Pages Using a CSV File | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Upload a List of Teams or Personal Pages Using a CSV File

CrowdChange allows you to upload multiple Team or Personal Fundraising Pages in bulk using a simple .CSV file. This feature is available within the **Manage Pages and Teams** section of your fundraiser dashboard.

## Step 1: Go to Manage Pages and Teams

1. Log in to your CrowdChange site.

2. Navigate to your fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

3. From the left sidebar, click **Manage pages and teams**.

You will see two tabs at the top of this screen (see below):  
![image-20251125-163938.png](../assets/how-to-upload-a-list-of-teams-or-personal-pages-us/image-20251125-163938.png)
View of the **Manage pages \& teams** feature

* **Teams**

* **Personal Pages**

**Be sure to click into the correct tab before uploading**, depending on whether you are uploading team pages or personal pages.

*** ** * ** ***

### Step 2: Download and Fill Out the Correct Template

Click the **Upload .csv file** button to initiate this process. To download the template, click **Download template.csv**(see below).  
![image-20251125-164155.png](../assets/how-to-upload-a-list-of-teams-or-personal-pages-us/image-20251125-164155.png)
View of how to download the .csv template for **Team fundraising pages**

Ensure that the **column headers are not changed**, and that all required fields are filled out. For example:

* **For Personal Pages:** Email, First Name, Last Name, Page Name, Fundraising Goal (optional depending on Fundraiser settings), and Team ID (optional if not linked to a team).

* **For Teams:** Email, First Name, Last Name, Page Name, Fundraising Goal (optional depending on Fundraiser settings).

*** ** * ** ***

### Step 3: Upload Your CSV

1. Click **Upload .csv file** in the top right.

2. Drag and drop your completed CSV or browse to select it.

3. Review the summary before confirming the upload.

**Important:** All rows are treated as new entries. Duplicates will not be merged, and the import cannot be undone once it begins.

*** ** * ** ***

### Finding the Team ID (For Personal Page Uploads Only)

If you are uploading personal pages and want them linked to teams, you must include the **Team ID**.

You can find the Team ID in two places:

* **Admin Teams Report:** This report shows a list of all teams and their unique IDs.

* **Team Page URL:** Visit the team page and copy the numeric value at the end of the URL.

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations- | Nav: Leaderboard Block - How to show a list of donations, team fundraising pages and personal fundraising pages on your fundraiser | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Leaderboard Block - How to show a list of donations, team fundraising pages and personal fundraising pages on your fundraiser

The **Leaderboard block** is available by default on all fundraisers, and can show a list of **Donations** , **Team fundraising pages** , and **Personal fundraising pages** depending on your required settings. This is a customizable and dynamic element of the fundraiser user interface, and can be used as a critical part of your online campaigns.

*** ** * ** ***

## How to edit the **Leaderboard block**

To edit the **Leaderboard block**, follow the below steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the **Fundraiser dashboard** , click **Design your fundraiser**

* Scroll to the **Leaderboard block** , and click the **Edit** button

![image-20251127-144347.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20251127-144347.png)
View of the **Leaderboard block** with the **Edit** button highlighted

*** ** * ** ***

## How to add a **Leaderboard block**

If your fundraiser is missing a leaderboard block, it is possible it was previously deleted. To restore or add a second leaderboard block, please follow these steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the **Fundraiser dashboard** , click **Design your fundraiser**

* Within the user interface, between any two blocks, click the **Plus** icon

* The list of available blocks will then be shown - select the **Leaderboard block**

![image-20251127-144841.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20251127-144841.png)
After clicking the **Plus** icon, select the **Leaderboard block**from the list to add this element

*** ** * ** ***

## Display options - how to show different leaderboards on Fundraiser, Team, and Personal Pages

The **Leaderboard block** can be shown, or hidden, on different areas of your fundraiser depending on your needs. Using the **Display options** function, you can decide if a leaderboard is visible on the main **Fundraiser page** , on a **Team page** , or on a **Personal fundraising page**. This functionality also allows you to have different leaderboards, with different settings, shown in these various places.

To adjust the **Leaderboard block** 's **Display options**, please follow these steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the **Fundraiser dashboard** , click **Design your fundraiser**

* Scroll to the **Leaderboard block** , and click the **Edit** button

* Click the **Display options** button

* You then can check off where you want this **Leaderboard block** to be featured

![image-20251127-150532.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20251127-150532.png)

As multiple **Leaderboard** **blocks** can be added to a single fundraiser, this can allow you to have, for example, a list of **Recent donations** on the main fundraiser page, but a list of **Top donations** shown on Team or Personal fundraising pages.

*** ** * ** ***

## **Leaderboard block** layout - how to adjust the order leaderboard elements are shown

By default, the **Leaderboard block** will show donations first, followed by Team fundraising pages, then Personal fundraising pages. This order, however, can be adjusted within the **Leaderboard block**'s edit functionality. To adjust this, please follow these steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the **Fundraiser dashboard** , click **Design your fundraiser**

* Scroll to the **Leaderboard block** , and click the **Edit** button

* Click the **Pencil icon**

* On the item you want to move, click the dots beside the **Donations** , **Teams** , or **Personal pages** and drag it to the desired new placement

* Once you are finished, click **Save**

![image-20251127-151648.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20251127-151648.png)
Drag the highlighted icon to move the placement of your **Leaderboard block** options

Whichever option is listed first will be what is shown by default on your fundraiser publicly.

*** ** * ** ***

## Setting up each tab of your **Leaderboard block**

Each element of the leaderboard block can be uniquely customized. To customize any of these elements, please follow these steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the **Fundraiser dashboard** , click **Design your fundraiser**

* Scroll to the **Leaderboard block** , and click the **Edit** button

* Click the **Pencil icon**

* On the element you would like to customize, click **Set up**

![image-20251127-152307.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20251127-152307.png)
The **Set up** option for **Donations** , **Teams** , and **Personal pages**

Additionally, any of these options can be hidden, if required, by toggling off the slider within each box.

### Donations

Within the **Donations**section, you can adjust the following items:

* **Title** - This allows you to adjust what this tab of your **Leaderboard block** is called.

* **Sorting** - here you can select whether or not to show your donations by **Top** (highest value donations listed first), or **Recent** (most recent donations shown first)

* **What information to show**

  * **Donation amount** - Here you can set the leaderboard to show donation values (default setting), or to hide these amounts. If hidden, the list will only show the donor's selected display name, but no donation value will be shown.

  * **Comment** - Here you can set whether or not optional comments made at the point of donation are shown (default settings) or hidden.

  * **Icons** - Here you can enable icons for various purchase options and types (**Apparel purchase** ,**Recurring donations** ,**Ticket purchase** ,**Sponsorship purchase** , **eCards purchase** ,and **Registration purchase**). These icons are pictured below.

![image-20251127-153510.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20251127-153510.png)
View of the **Icons** options within the **Leaderboard block**

* **Date conditions** - Here you can specify which transactions are shown using specific date periods.

* **Amount raised conditions** - This function can be used to hide donations from the leaderboard that either do not meet, or exceed, specific donation value.

### Teams

* **Title** - This allows you to adjust what this tab of your **Leaderboard block** is called.

* **Sorting** - here you can select whether or not to show your donations by **Top** (highest value total page donations listed first), or **Recent** (most recently created Teams shown first)

* **What information to show**

  * **Donation amount** - Here you can set whether or not the Leaderboard block displays the total raised by the Team Fundraising Page

* **Date conditions** - Here you can specify which teams are shown using specific date periods. This is based on the creation date of the Team.

* **Amount raised conditions** - This function can be used to hide teams from the leaderboard that either do not meet, or exceed, specific total donation value.

### Personal pages

* **Title** - This allows you to adjust what this tab of your **Leaderboard block** is called.

* **Sorting** - here you can select whether or not to show your Personal pages by **Top** (highest value total page donations listed first), or **Recent** (most recently created pages shown first)

* **What information to show**

  * **Donation amount** - Here you can set whether or not the Leaderboard block displays the total raised by the Personal Fundraising Page.

* **Date conditions** - Here you can specify which pages are shown using specific date periods. This is based on the creation date of the page.

* **Amount raised conditions** - This function can be used to hide pages from the leaderboard that either do not meet, or exceed, specific total donation value.

*** ** * ** ***

## **Item display type** settings

The **Item display type** settings allow you to decide how the various entries in your **Leaderboard block** are displayed. There are two options as to how this is displayed, each with their own settings.

* **Standard** - This is the default setting for the **Leaderboard block** . This is the standardized list of Donations, Teams, and Personal pages. You can select as few as **one** and as many as **ten** items to display on this list at a time. Please note that the **View all**button at the bottom of the leaderboard will always be available (unless manually turned off), so all donors, teams, and pages will still be accessible, even if your total number of these items exceeds your list options.

* **Scrollable list** - This option allows your leaderboard to be scrollable, allowing for a longer list, that takes up less room. The **Auto-scroll animation** option causes the leaderboard to automatically scroll through entries, injecting some dynamic animation into your fundraiser.

*** ** * ** ***

## The **View all** button

The **View all** button allows users to browse entries within the leaderboard that fall outside of the settings assigned in the **Item display type** settings section. If you only want to show the options set in this area, you can uncheck the box beside the **Show "View all" button** option.  
![image-20251127-160857.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20251127-160857.png)
You can turn off the **View all**button by toggling this function off

*** ** * ** ***

## Appearance

You can adjust the colors of your **Leaderboard block** within the **Appearance** section. By default, the fundraiser's theme settings are used here.  
![image-20251127-161210.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20251127-161210.png)
Colors are assigned using hex codes, or using the color picker

*** ** * ** ***

## **Content** option - how to change the title of your **Leaderboard block**

The **Content** option allows you to change the title of your **Leaderboard block** . You can also change this by clicking the title within the user interface. If changes are made here, please ensure you click **Save** after the fact.  
![image-20251127-161450.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20251127-161450.png)
**Leaderboard block** title can be adjusted either by clicking the title in the user interface, or by using the **Content** section of the **Leaderboard Block** 's **Edit** module

*** ** * ** ***

## Reactions - how to allow emoji reactions on Leaderboard donations

The **Reactions** setting allows visitors to add emoji reactions to donations shown in the **Donations** tab of your Leaderboard block. When enabled, each donation card will display reaction icons (with counts) and an option to add a reaction, helping supporters engage with and celebrate donations publicly.  
![image-20260304-160806.png](../assets/leaderboard-block-how-to-show-a-list-of-donations-/image-20260304-160806.png)
The **Leaderboard block** with **Reactions** enabled

### How to enable Reactions

To turn on Reactions for donations, follow these steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the Fundraiser dashboard, click **Design your fundraiser**

* Scroll to the **Leaderboard** block, and click the **Edit** button

* Under **Donations** , click **Set up**

* Scroll to **What information to show**

* Check the box beside **Reactions**

* Click **Save**

### How to disable Reactions

If you would like to remove reactions from donation cards, return to the same menu and uncheck **Reactions** , then click **Save**.

================================================================================

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/how-to-assign-tickets-to-different-attendees-durin | Nav: How to Assign Tickets to Different Attendees During Checkout | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# How to Assign Tickets to Different Attendees During Checkout

Our "Assign Tickets During Checkout" feature makes it easier than ever for purchasers to distribute individual tickets to multiple attendees in a single transaction. This is ideal for group purchases and improves the check-in experience at your event.

*** ** * ** ***

## Enabling the Feature

To enable this setting for your fundraiser:

1. Log in to your CrowdChange site.

2. Go to your fundraiser and click **Manage Fundraiser**.

3. In the left-hand menu, click **Purchase Options** , then select **Tickets**.

4. Scroll to the **Assign tickets during checkout** option and toggle it **ON**.

5. Click **Save** at the bottom of the page to apply your changes.

![image-20260115-155018.png](../assets/how-to-assign-tickets-to-different-attendees-durin/image-20260115-155018.png)
View of the **Assign tickets during checkout**feature being toggled on

Once enabled, users will be able to assign a name and email address to each ticket during the checkout process.

*** ** * ** ***

### How It Works for Ticket purchasers

When a ticket purchaser selects more than one ticket at checkout, they will see a new step where they can assign each ticket individually.

* Required fields: **First Name** , **Last Name** , and **Email**

* Optional fields: **Phone Number** and any **Custom Questions** you've added

* Donors can select "Same as previous" to speed up entry if multiple tickets are for the same person

![image-20260115-155309.png](../assets/how-to-assign-tickets-to-different-attendees-durin/image-20260115-155309.png)
View of **Assign ticket**button on checkout page

*** ** * ** ***

### How Tickets Are Delivered

Each assigned attendee will receive their ticket via email, along with the following:

* A **PDF ticket attachment** (for printing or saving)

* A button to add the tickets to your **Apple Wallet** or **Google Wallet**

* A **QR code** embedded directly in the email for quick scanning at the event

The purchaser will also receive a full summary email containing all ticket details, including copies of each assigned ticket.

*** ** * ** ***

### Reporting \& Admin Access

To view assigned ticket data:

1. Log in to your CrowdChange site.

2. Go to your fundraiser and click **Manage fundraiser**.

3. Click **Reports** on the left-hand menu

4. Select **Tickets report**

The report will include each ticket holder's name, email, phone (if collected), and their assigned ticket(s).

# Cover Image Block - How to update the banner image on your fundraiser

The Cover image block (also referred to as the banner or hero image) appears at the top of your fundraiser and is one of the most visible elements of your public-facing page. It helps set the tone for your campaign and supports your branding.  
![image-20260303-163955.png](../assets/cover-image-block-how-to-update-the-banner-image-o/image-20260303-163955.png)
View of the **Cover image block** using the **Fullscreen** layout on a fundraiser

*** ** * ** ***

## How to edit the Cover image block

To edit the Cover image block, follow the below steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the Fundraiser dashboard, click **Design your fundraiser**

* Hover over the fundraiser's current cover image and click **Edit**

* On the right sidebar that appears, scroll down and expand the **Content** section

* Click the pencil icon to change the current image

* Select the new image from your computer, crop and edit if desired, and click **Save**

* At the bottom of the sidebar, click **Save** to confirm and publish your changes

![image-20260303-165019.png](../assets/cover-image-block-how-to-update-the-banner-image-o/image-20260303-165019.png)
The **Edit** button on the **Cover image block** within the **Design your fundraiser** function

*** ** * ** ***

## Cover image block layouts

Within the **Layout** section of the Cover image block, you can choose how your banner image is displayed at the top of your fundraiser. Each layout option offers a slightly different visual presentation to match your campaign style. Once a layout is selected, images are then added in the **Content** section. Below is a list of the potential layouts used in the **Cover image block**.

* **Full screen** (default) - Displays your cover image across the full width of the page in a bold, immersive hero format. This layout is ideal for high-impact visuals and branding-focused campaigns.

* **Gallery** - Allows you to upload multiple images that rotate in a slideshow format, creating a dynamic and engaging visual experience for visitors.

* **Centered** - Displays the image in a more contained format with content centered on the page, offering a balanced and structured look.

* **Sideway** - Positions the image beside your key content instead of above it, creating a split-layout design. This layout can be aligned left or right.

Each image format has different recommended dimensions - these are listed below. Please note that regardless of Layout settings, the **mobile** version of your cover image remains the same.  

| **Cover image format** | **Dimensions** |
|------------------------|----------------|
| Full screen            | 1920x699       |
| Gallery                | 1920x699       |
| Centered               | 1228x420       |
| Sideway                | 1056x1000      |
| Mobile                 | 750x480        |

*** ** * ** ***

### Using a video in place of your Cover Image

You can use an externally hosted **Video** on your fundraiser in place of your **Cover image** . CrowdChange can host videos, or live streams hosted on **Youtube** , **Vimeo** , or **Twitch** . Please note that these videos must be available publicly in order to show up on your page - they cannot be private. Unlisted videos are supported as long as the link is accessible to all. **Livestream links** , as well as **Youtube Shorts** are both supported via the **Cover image block**.

If you choose to feature a video on your page, it will automatically play upon accessing the fundraiser - the video will be muted, unless the user clicks on it, in which case it will popup over the screen, and play with sound.

While this replaces your cover image on the fundraiser page, the fundraiser tile on the main CrowdChange site, and meta images (for sharing on social media and other sources) are still drawn from the Cover Image, so please ensure you still have something added in this area.

*** ** * ** ***

### Customizing Buttons

You can adjust what **buttons** are displayed within the **Cover image block** , what text is shown on each button, and how each button is displayed on **mobile devices** , as well as on **Personal** and **Team fundraising pages**.

To access this element of the **Cover image block**, follow these steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the Fundraiser dashboard, click **Design your fundraiser**

* Hover over the fundraiser's current cover image and click **Edit**

* On the right sidebar that appears, scroll down and expand the **Buttons** section

Once you have expanded the **Buttons** section, you can edit each individual button. You are able to:

* Adjust the text on each button (for example, you could change *Tickets* to display *Buy tickets*)

* Decide which button is shown in which order by dragging and dropping the button up or down

* Decide if a button is always shown on mobile (by default the first button will be shown, and other options will be hidden behind an expandable menu - this is for space saving purposes

* Adjust whether or not the button is **Filled** or **Outlined**

* On Personal and Team Pages, you can choose whether or not a button is shown at all, and if it is shown, whether or not the settings shown on the main fundraiser page are adopted, or unique settings are applied

================================================================================

# Sharing Block - Social media, QR Codes, Email, SMS, and more

The **Sharing block** allows users to share **Fundraisers** , **Team pages** , and **Personal pages** across a variety of social media platforms. This also allows users to send pre-written **email** and **SMS messages** , **as well as generate unique QR codes** for Fundraisers, Team pages and Personal pages.  
![image-20260303-205341.png](../assets/sharing-block-social-media-qr-codes-email-sms-and-/image-20260303-205341.png)
The **Sharing block** is shown above, with options for **Facebook** , **X** , **LinkedIn** , **WhatsApp** , **QR Code** generation, **SMS** , **Email** , **Link** copy and paste, and **Share with other options** displayed

Fundraiser owners can determine which of the above-mentioned options are shown using the **Design your fundraiser** functionality - to edit the **Sharing block**, follow these steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the Fundraiser dashboard, click **Design your fundraiser**

* Hover over the **Sharing block** and click **Edit**

* On the right sidebar that appears, scroll down and expand the **Layout** section

* Here you can decide what is shown in your Sharing block

* At the bottom of the sidebar, click **Save** to confirm and publish your changes

![image-20260303-205705.png](../assets/sharing-block-social-media-qr-codes-email-sms-and-/image-20260303-205705.png)
The **Edit** area of the **Sharing block**

You can also decide how these icons are displayed, as well as the text shown on the Sharing block, as well as background settings.

*** ** * ** ***

The **Sharing block** allows users to share using the following social media platforms:

* Facebook

* X (formerly Twitter)

* LinkedIn

* WhatsApp

If these options are selected, users will be prompted to either use a pre-written sharing message, which can be copied and pasted, or to write their own message. Once this is decided, the user will be taken directly to the social media platform selected. Please note that without an account on the social media platform in question, posts cannot be shared.

*** ** * ** ***

The **SMS** and **Email** functionality within the **Sharing block** allows users to send text messages and emails directly from CrowdChange, with no requirement to log in to their email account or link a phone number to the platform. These messages are templated, and are not editable by the users.  
![image-20260303-210100.png](../assets/sharing-block-social-media-qr-codes-email-sms-and-/image-20260303-210100.png)
An example of the pre-written **Email** option using the **Sharing block**  
At this time these messages are predetermined by CrowdChange and are not adjustable. For more detailed email messages, please use the **Mailing List**function

# Donation Progress Block - how to track amount raised and goals on your fundraiser

The **Donation progress block** displays key fundraising metrics on your fundraiser page, including the total amount raised, your goal (if enabled), and optional totals like **Raised by teams** , **Raised by pages** , and **Donors**.

This block now supports **stretch goals**, meaning that if your fundraiser exceeds its goal, the progress indicator can display progress above 100%, and you can optionally show a "goal exceeded" celebration hint and customize the exceeded progress colors.

If your fundraiser has a goal enabled, it will be shown in the **Donation progress block** . If you elect to display this block without a goal set, it will count **overall funds raised**, without showing a goal.  
![image-20260304-150241.png](../assets/donation-progress-block-how-to-track-amount-raised/image-20260304-150241.png)
The **Donation progress block** on a peer-to-peer fundraiser

*** ** * ** ***

## How to edit the Donation progress block

To edit the Donation progress block, follow the below steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and Log in

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the Fundraiser dashboard, click **Design your fundraiser**

* Scroll to the **Donation progress** block, and click the **Edit** button

* Make your updates (Layout, Appearance, Content, etc.)

* Click **Save** to publish your changes

*** ** * ** ***

## How to add a Donation progress block

If your fundraiser is missing a Donation progress block, it is possible it was previously deleted. To restore it, please follow these steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and Log in

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the Fundraiser dashboard, click **Design your fundraiser**

* Within the user interface, between any two blocks, click the **Plus** icon

* The list of available blocks will then be shown, select the **Donation progress** block

* Click **Save** if prompted

*** ** * ** ***

## Layout options

Within the **Layout** section, you can control how the Donation progress block is displayed on the page:

* **One column** - Displays your fundraising progress in a single, streamlined section.

* **Two columns** - Displays a larger primary panel on the left (for example, total raised and the progress chart) and a secondary panel on the right for additional stats (for example, raised by teams, raised by pages, donors).

### Primary block

The **Primary block** is the main metric shown in the Donation progress block. In the **Raised amounts** section, you can choose to display:

* **Raised amount**

* **Goal**

If the **Goal** is enabled, you can edit the goal amount directly in this panel. Please note, updating this goal value will also update the fundraiser goal in the fundraiser's **General settings**.

### Secondary blocks

The **Secondary blocks** section allows you to show or hide additional fundraising stats, such as:

* **Raised by teams**

* **Raised by pages**

* **Donors**

You can toggle each secondary block on or off. If needed, you can also promote a secondary stat to be the main display by selecting **Make primary**.

*** ** * ** ***

## Stretch goals and goal exceeded settings

When your fundraiser exceeds its goal, the Donation progress block can visually display progress beyond 100% (for example, 115%), which supports stretch goal momentum and helps communicate that the campaign is continuing to grow.

Within the **Appearance** settings, you can also enable and customize:

* **Celebrate goal reached** - Shows a celebration confetti effect when the goal is reached.

* **Exceeded goal hint** - Displays a short celebration label near the progress chart when the goal is exceeded (the text is customizable, and is designed for short messages like "Goal exceeded!" or a stretch goal callout).

* **Exceeded progress bar color** - Allows you to set a separate color for the exceeded portion of the progress bar or chart, making stretch progress visually distinct from standard progress.

Tip: If you are testing these settings while editing, use the fundraiser preview in the **Design your fundraiser** view to confirm how the goal reached and goal exceeded states look before publishing.

*** ** * ** ***

## Appearance

The **Appearance** section controls how the Donation progress block looks, including the progress visualization and colors.

### Progress bar style

You can choose between:

* **Donut chart** - A circular progress chart, ideal for highlighting percent-to-goal.

* **Horizontal bar** - A more traditional progress bar display.

### Color settings

You can also customize:

* Background color

* Primary block background color and text color

* Secondary block background color and text color

* Progress bar color

* Filled progress bar color

* Exceeded progress bar color (stretch goals)

<!-- Source: https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak/gallery-block-how-to-add-an-image-gallery-to-the-b | Nav: Gallery Block - How to add an image gallery to the body of your fundraising page | Mirrored 2026-10-14 -->

# Gallery Block - How to add an image gallery to the body of your fundraising page

The **Gallery block** allows you to add a photo gallery directly within the body of your fundraiser page. This is a great way to showcase event photos, highlight your impact, recognize sponsors, or add visual storytelling throughout your campaign.

You can upload **up to 20 images** into a single Gallery block, customize the gallery title, select a layout style, and adjust basic colour settings to match your fundraiser branding.  
![image-20260304-153059.png](../assets/gallery-block-how-to-add-an-image-gallery-to-the-b/image-20260304-153059.png)
The **Gallery block** using the **Modular** layout

*** ** * ** ***

## How to add a Gallery block

The **Gallery block**is not enabled by default. To add a Gallery block, please follow these steps:

* Go to your CrowdChange page and **Log in**

* Once on the fundraiser you would like to edit, click **Manage fundraiser**

* Once on the Fundraiser dashboard, click **Design your fundraiser**

* Within the user interface, between any two blocks, click the **Plus** icon

* The list of available blocks will then be shown, select the **Gallery block**

*** ** * ** ***

## Content - how to set your gallery title and upload images

Within the **Content** section of the Gallery block editor, you can:

### Gallery title

* Update the **Gallery title** (for example, "Event Photos", "Impact Highlights", or "In the Community")

* If left as-is, the default title will display as **Gallery**

### Images

In the **Images** section, you can upload the photos you want displayed in the gallery.

Supported file rules:

* Accepted formats: **JPG, PNG, GIF**

* Maximum number of images: **20**

* Maximum file size: **25MB per image**

Tip: For the best visual results, use clear, high-resolution images with consistent lighting and similar aspect ratios where possible.

*** ** * ** ***

## Layout - how to choose how your gallery displays

Within the **Layout** section, you can select how your gallery images are arranged on the page. Layout availability may vary depending on your fundraiser setup.

Common layout options include:

* **Modular** - Displays your images in a dynamic grid layout, designed to create a visually engaging gallery with a mix of image sizes.

* **Stack** - Displays images in a simpler stacked layout, ideal for a clean, straightforward photo list.

* **Carousel** - Displays images in a rotating slider format, ideal when you want visitors to browse photos without taking up as much vertical page space.

*** ** * ** ***

## Appearance - how to adjust colours

Within the **Appearance** section of the Gallery block editor, you can customize:

* **Title text color** - Controls the colour of the Gallery title text.

* **Background color** - Controls the background colour behind the gallery block.

# Email Center - How to send emails from CrowdChange

The **Email center** allows you to communicate directly with your supporters by managing contacts, creating reusable templates, and sending emails from within your CrowdChange site.

The Email Center is available at the site-wide, fundraiser, team, and personal page levels, making it easy to reach the right audience based on your role.

*** ** * ** ***

## Accessing the Email Center

You can access the Email Center from multiple areas of your dashboard:

* **Fundraiser level** : Click **Manage fundraiser** , then select **Email center** from the left-hand menu.

* **Team or Personal page level** : Click **Manage page/team** , then select **Email center**.

*** ** * ** ***

## Overview

Once inside the Email Center, you will see three main options:

* **Manage contacts**

* **Templates**

* **Send emails**

Each section is designed to help you organize your audience and streamline your communication.

*** ** * ** ***

## Manage Contacts

The **Manage contacts** section allows you to build and organize your email recipient list.

### Adding Contacts

You can add contacts in several ways:

* **Manually**: Add contacts one at a time by entering:

  * First name

  * Last name

  * Email address

  * Preferred notification language (for bilingual sites)

  * Label (if you want to categorize contacts by group)

![image-20260421-133825.png](../assets/email-center-how-to-send-emails-from-crowdchange/image-20260421-133825.png)

* **Import from Google**: Connect your Gmail account to import contacts directly.

* **Upload a CSV file**: Upload a contact list using the provided CSV template.

![image-20260421-133742.png](../assets/email-center-how-to-send-emails-from-crowdchange/image-20260421-133742.png)

### Contact Labels

Contacts may include pre-existing labels to help you organize and filter recipients. These can include:

* Donors

* Previous donors

* Team captains

You can use these labels when selecting recipients for your emails. Custom labels can be added when adding contacts manually.

*** ** * ** ***

## Templates

The **Templates** section allows you to create and reuse email templates for consistent communication.

### Template Availability

Templates can be created at different levels, which determines who can access them:

* **Site-wide templates**: Available across all fundraisers, teams, and personal pages.

* **Fundraiser-level templates**: Available to the fundraiser owner, as well as all teams and personal pages within that fundraiser.

* **Team-level templates**: Available to the team captain and all personal pages within the team.

* **Personal page templates**: Available only to the page owner.

Templates help save time and ensure consistent messaging across your campaign.

*** ** * ** ***

## Send Emails

The **Send emails** section allows you to compose and send messages to your contacts.

### Step 1: Set Sender Information

Before composing your email, you will need to confirm your sender details:

* If your account email is already verified, it will be selected by default.

* If not, you will be prompted to verify your email address.

* You can also add and verify a different sender email if needed.

### Step 2: Create Your Email

You can either:

* Start from scratch, or

* Select an existing template (if available)

You will then be able to:

* Enter a subject line

* Write your message content

If a template is selected, this will also be editable.

If you have created a new email, you can optionally save it as a **Template** for future use.

### Dynamic Tags

Dynamic tags allow you to personalize your emails. For example:

* `{first-name}`

* `{last-name}`

* `{full-name}`

To view all available tags, click **See all available tags** below the message editor.

### Step 3: Select Recipients

After creating your message, click **Next** to choose your recipients.

You can:

* Filter contacts by label (for example, Donors or Team Captains)

* Select individual contacts

* Use the checkbox at the top of the list to select all visible contacts, with the option to select all contacts in your list

### Step 4: Preview and Send

You will be taken to a preview screen where you can:

* Review your message

* Confirm your recipient list

Once ready:

* You can **Schedule**when your email is sent, or leave this toggle off if you want to send instantly

* Complete the reCAPTCHA verification

* Click **Send** to deliver your email

*** ** * ** ***

## Bilingual Behavior

If your CrowdChange site is set to bilingual, the Email Center includes language-specific functionality to ensure recipients receive communications in their preferred language.

* When adding contacts manually or uploading a CSV file, you will be prompted to select a preferred notification language for each contact.

* The **Send preview email** function will always send both the English and French versions of your message to you.

* Recipients will only receive the version of the email that matches their selected language preference.

* Contacts such as Donors, Previous Donors, and Team Captains will have their language set automatically based on the language used when they created their account or made their first donation.

* If a user would like to update their language preference, they can do so through the **Notifications** section of their profile.
